programme.title: Jamas Stipsits / Jamas Stipsits
programme.desc: Thomas Stipsits is a proud Greek by choice and has done a lot in his life that can be successfully toasted: he is a cabaret artist, actor, musician and author. He is accompanied here on his journey to selected stations in his life. / Thomas Stipsits ist ein stolzer Wahlgrieche und hat viel gemacht in seinem Leben, auf das man erfolgreich anstoSSen kann: er ist Kabarettist, Schauspieler, Musiker und Autor. Auf der Reise zu ausgewahlten Stationen seines Leben wird er hier begleitet.

programme.title: Brass Palmas - Joy, Fun and Brass Music in the Sun / Brass Palmas - Joy, Fun und Blasmusik in the Sun
programme.desc: The program reports on the large brass music festival Brass Palmas, which will also take place in 2024 with numerous bands from the genres of folk music, jazz, funk, rock and pop. Conny Deutsch und Fanny Stapf erleben ein Festival der besonderen Art.

programme.desc: The program presents the drawing of the winning numbers of the Eurodreams gambling game. / Die Sendung prasentiert die Ziehung der Gewinnerzahlen des Eurodreams-Glucksspiels.

programme.title: The Pier - The strange side of love / The Pier - Die fremde Seite der Liebe
programme.desc: The young architect Alejandra is devastated by her husband's suicide. She discovers that he was leading a double life with another woman. She decides to approach the woman under a different identity. / Die junge Architektin Alejandra wird durch den Selbstmord ihres Mannes erschuttert. Sie entdeckt, dass er mit einer anderen Frau ein Doppelleben fuhrte. Sie beschlieSSt, sich der Frau unter einer anderen Identitat zu nahern.

programme.title: The Sinner / The Sinner
programme.desc: Detective Harry Ambrose returns to his hometown on the outskirts of New York to solve a disturbing and heartbreaking crime: an 11-year-old boy is said to have murdered his parents with no apparent motive. Ambrose quickly realizes that this is no ordinary child. His investigation took him deep into the hidden darkness of his hometown. There are people there who will stop at nothing to protect their secrets. This also includes the mysterious Vera. / Detective Harry Ambrose kehrt in seine Heimatstadt am Rande von New York zuruck, um ein beunruhigendes und zugleich herzzerreiSSendes Verbrechen aufzuklaren: Ein 11-jahriger Junge soll ohne ersichtliches Motiv seine Eltern ermordet haben. Ambrose erkennt schnell, dass es sich nicht um ein gewohnliches Kind handelt. Seine Ermittlungen fuhren ihn tief in die verborgene Dunkelheit seiner Heimatstadt. Dort gibt es Menschen, die vor nichts zuruckschrecken, um ihre Geheimnisse zu schutzen. Dazu gehort auch die mysteriose Vera.

programme.title: Shameless / Shameless
programme.desc: Frank Gallagher lives as a single father with his six children. However, he spends most of his time in the bar and prefers to spend the little money the family has on alcohol instead of food. His eldest daughter Fiona is forced to take on the role of mother to her siblings: the intelligent but petty criminal Lip, Ian, who hides his homosexuality, the responsible but fragile Debbie, the violent 10-year-old Carl and little Liam. Together, the children try to master their lives in a creative, scandalless, but also warm-hearted way, despite their impossible father. / Frank Gallagher lebt als alleinerziehender Vater mit seinen sechs Kindern zusammen. Allerdings verbringt er die meiste Zeit in der Bar und gibt das wenige Geld, das der Familie zur Verfugung steht, statt fur Essen lieber fur Alkohol aus. Seine alteste Tochter Fiona ubernimmt notgedrungen die Mutterrolle fur ihre Geschwister: den intelligenten aber kleinkriminellen Lip, Ian, der seine Homosexualitat verbirgt, die verantwortungsbewusste aber fragile Debbie, den 10-jahrigen gewalttatigen Carl und den kleinen Liam. Gemeinsam versuchen die Kinder, trotz ihres unmoglichen Vaters ihr Leben auf kreative, skandalose, aber auch warmherzige Weise zu meistern.

programme.title: Navy CIS: L.A. / Navy CIS: L.A.
programme.desc: The special unit of the Navy CIS L.A. is deployed in cases involving the national security of the United States of America. The excellently trained professionals give their best during the dangerous undercover operations. / Die Spezialeinheit der Navy CIS L. A. ist bei Fallen der nationalen Sicherheit der Vereinigten Staaten Amerikas im Einsatz. Die hervorragend ausgebildeten Profis geben bei den gefahrlichen Undercover-Einsatzen ihr Bestes.

programme.title: Mom / Mom
programme.desc: Christy Plunkett had her daughter Violet when she was 16 and has a son named Roscoe with her ex-husband. Christy has been sober for a year now and is still struggling with her addiction. She works as a waitress in a restaurant and has an affair with her married boss. One day she decides to turn her life around and even attends Alcoholics Anonymous meetings. She gets help from her mother Bonnie, of all people. She was an alcoholic and drug addict herself and was therefore unable to take much care of her daughter Christy when she was a child. Now she wants to make amends and is trying to regain her daughter's trust. Bonnie finally wants to start being a good mother to Christy, chaos included. / Christy Plunkett bekam ihre Tochter Violet mit 16 Jahren und hat einen Sohn namens Roscoe gemeinsam mit ihrem Ex-Mann. Seit einem Jahr ist Christy nun trocken und hat immer noch schwer mit ihrer Sucht zu kampfen. Sie arbeitet als Kellnerin in einem Restaurant und hat eine Affare mit ihrem verheirateten Chef. Eines Tages fasst sie den Entschluss, ihr Leben umzukrempeln und besucht sogar Treffen der Anonymen Alkoholiker. Hilfe bekommt sie ausgerechnet von ihrer Mutter Bonnie. Sie war selbst alkoholsuchtig und drogenabhangig und konnte sich daher nur wenig um Tochter Christy kummern, als die ein Kind war. Nun will sie das wiedergutmachen und versucht, das Vertrauen ihrer Tochter wiederzugewinnen. Bonnie will endlich damit anfangen, eine gute Mutter fur Christy zu sein, Chaos inklusive.

programme.title: Formula 1 highlights / Formel 1 Highlights
programme.desc: The show offers all the action, all the highlights and summaries of Formula 1. / Die Sendung bietet die ganze Action, alle Highlights und Zusammenfassungen der Formel 1.

programme.title: ZIB Zack Mini / ZIB Zack Mini
programme.desc: The program conveys connections and backgrounds for six to ten year olds every day. / Die Sendung vermittelt taglich Zusammenhange und Hintergrunde fur Sechs- bis Zehnjahrige.

programme.title: Pippi Longstocking / Pippi Langstrumpf
programme.desc: Pippi Longstocking is a cheeky nine-year-old girl with freckles, two sticky red braids and different colored stockings. She lives without parents, but with a horse and a monkey in a large, colorful villa. She doesn't let anyone dictate anything to her, she is brave, generous and so strong that she can even lift her horse. Together with her friends Tommy and Annika she experiences the craziest adventures. / Pippi Langstrumpf ist ein freches neunjahriges Madchen mit Sommersprossen, zwei abstehenden roten Zopfen und unterschiedlich gefarbten Strumpfen. Sie lebt ohne Eltern, aber mit einem Pferd und einem Affen in einer groSSen bunten Villa. Sie lasst sich von niemandem etwas vorschreiben, ist mutig, groSSzugig und so stark, dass sie sogar ihr Pferd hochstemmen kann. Zusammen mit ihren Freunden Tommy und Annika erlebt sie die verrucktesten Abenteuer.

programme.title: The hunt for the Kju Wang / Die Jagd nach dem Kju Wang
programme.desc: The city of Venice, inhabited by birds, is ruled by a powerful duke. This duke owns a valuable gemstone, the Kju-Wang, which symbolizes his power. The ambassador of a foreign country wants to steal the Kju-Wang. / Die Stadt Venedig, die von Vogeln bewohnt wird, wird von einem machtigen Herzog regiert. Dieser Herzog besitzt einen wertvollen Edelstein den Kju-Wang, der seine Macht symbolisiert. Der Botschafter eines fremden Landes will den Kju-Wang stehlen.

programme.title: Hello Kasperl / Servus Kasperl
programme.desc: The show presents painting competitions, birthday greetings and stories with Punch and Judy. / Die Sendung prasentiert Malwettbewerbe, GeburtstagsgruSSe und Geschichten mit dem Kasperl.

programme.title: The miracle YOU / Das Wunder DU
programme.desc: The children's program deals with scientific topics relating to the human body. / Die Kindersendung befasst sich mit wissenschaftlichen Themen rund um den menschlichen Korper.

programme.title: Great animals / Tolle Tiere
programme.desc: Kurt the cat goes on a journey through the Schonbrunn Zoo. It introduces native and exotic wild animals as well as popular and unusual pets. As zoo helpers, two children also experience working with the zoo animals up close. / Kater Kurt begibt sich auf eine Reise durch den Tiergarten Schonbrunn. Er stellt heimische und exotische Wildtiere sowie beliebte und ungewohnliche Haustiere vor. Als Zoohelfer erleben zwei Kinder zudem hautnah die Arbeit mit den Zootieren.

programme.title: Kiwi / Kiwi
programme.desc: Twini and Twiki are two animals made of plasticine who want to teach us English words through funny stories. Because every occasion is good for discovering some vocabulary and their spelling and learning them in a playful way. / Twini und Twiki sind zwei Tiere aus Knetmasse, die uns in lustigen Geschichten englische Worter naherbringen wollen. Denn jeder Anlass ist gut geeignet, um einige Vokabeln sowie deren Schreibweise zu entdecken und spielerisch zu lernen.

programme.title: Garfield / Garfield
programme.sub-title: Miese Maschinen: Sieg uber die Technik
programme.desc: Garfield, the world's laziest cat, is back and has more fun adventures. Garfield's quirky misadventures here are generally rougher and more bizarre than in the past. / Garfield, der faulste Kater der Welt ist zuruck und erlebt noch mehr witzige Abenteuer. Dabei fallen Garfields schrullige Missgeschicke hier in der Regel derber und bizarrer aus als in der Vergangenheit.

programme.title: ZIB Zack Mini / ZIB Zack Mini
programme.desc: The program conveys connections and backgrounds for six to ten year olds every day. / Die Sendung vermittelt taglich Zusammenhange und Hintergrunde fur Sechs- bis Zehnjahrige.

programme.title: Malcolm in the middle / Malcolm mittendrin
programme.desc: A gifted child has to deal with his eccentric family. The Cleavers are a middle-class American family with a chaotic everyday life. Little Malcom uses his intelligence to plan pranks with his brothers. / Ein hochbegabtes Kind muss mit seiner exzentrischen Familie umgehen. Die Cleavers sind eine mittelstandische US-Familie mit chaotischem Alltagsleben. Der kleine Malcom nutzt seine Intelligenz, um mit seinen Brudern Streiche auszuhecken.

programme.title: Erste Bank Open 2025 / Erste Bank Open 2025
Smart10 - The quiz with the ten possibilities / Smart10 - Das Quiz mit den zehn Moglichkeiten
programme.desc: Two teams of two compete against each other in the knowledge duel hosted by Caroline Athanasiadis. The participants have to demonstrate general knowledge, good teamwork, tactics and risk assessment in order to be successful. / Zwei Zweierteams treten im Wissensduell bei Caroline Athanasiadis gegeneinander an. Dabei mussen die Teilnehmer Allgemeinwissen, gutes Teamwork, Taktik und Risikoeinschatzung unter Beweis stellen, um erfolgreich abzuschneiden.

programme.title: Q1 One note is incorrect / Q1 Ein Hinweis ist falsch
programme.desc: This quiz is all about clues. First, the topic of the searched term is announced. The candidates are supposed to get on the right track with the help of four clues - but only three of them are correct. / Bei diesem Quiz dreht sich alles um Hinweise. Zuerst wird das Thema des gesuchten Begriffes bekannt gegeben. Mithilfe von vier Hinweisen sollen die Kandidaten auf die richtige Spur kommen - doch nur drei davon sind richtig.

programme.title: Asked - hunted / Gefragt - Gejagt
programme.desc: In the quiz show, a team of four candidates competes against the “Jager”. This is not an easy task, because the “Jagers” are proven quiz professionals from the German national quiz team, including the German quiz master. In the first round, the candidates individually build up a game total, which they have to defend together against the “Jager” in the second round in order to advance to the final. In the final, the remaining candidates in the team compete against the “Jager” and defend the money they have earned so far. You must answer as many questions as possible within two minutes. If the candidates answer more questions correctly than the “Jager”, they win. / In der Quizsendung tritt ein Team von vier Kandidaten gegen den "Jager" an. Dies ist keine leichte Aufgabe, denn die "Jager" sind ausgewiesene Quizprofis aus der deutschen Quiznationalmannschaft, darunter sogar der Deutsche Quizmaster. In der ersten Runde bauen die Kandidaten einzeln eine Spielsumme auf, die sie in der zweiten Runde gemeinsam gegen den "Jager" verteidigen mussen, um in das Finale einzuziehen. Im Finale treten die verbliebenen Kandidaten im Team gegen den "Jager" an und verteidigen das bisher erspielte Geld. Sie mussen innerhalb von zwei Minuten so viele Fragen wie moglich beantworten. Beantworten die Kandidaten mehr Fragen als der "Jager" richtig, haben sie gewonnen.

programme.title: Death in Paradise / Death in Paradise
programme.desc: A gruesome violent crime occurs on the Caribbean island of Sainte-Marie. To clear it up, London investigator Richard Poole is assigned to the case. The new environment is actually fantastic, but he can't get used to the Caribbean mentality at all. This always creates entertaining situations. The meticulous suit wearer manages to solve the case together with his colleagues on site. They really want to keep him in the Caribbean. He doesn't even like seafood. / Auf der Karibikinsel Sainte-Marie geschieht ein grausames Gewaltverbrechen. Um es aufzuklaren, wird der Londoner Ermittler Richard Poole auf den Fall angesetzt. Die neue Umgebung ist eigentlich traumhaft, doch er kann sich uberhaupt nicht mit der karibischen Mentalitat anfreunden. Das sorgt immer wieder fur unterhaltsame Situationen. Dem peniblen Anzugtrager gelingt es, den Fall gemeinsam mit den Kollegen vor Ort zu losen. Die wollen ihn unbedingt in der Karibik behalten. Dabei mag er nicht einmal Meeresfruchte.

programme.title: Monk / Monk
programme.sub-title: Mr. Monk und das auSSerirdische Alibi
programme.desc: The detective Adrian Monk quickly became a minor celebrity due to his special skills in his job. He has a photographic memory and can create a trail from even the smallest clues. However, since the death of his beloved wife Trudy in a mysterious attack, he has suffered from severe anxiety and obsessive-compulsive disorder, which led to his suspension from duty with the San Francisco Police Department. After locking himself in his apartment for three years, he finally sets up his own business as a private detective and is repeatedly asked by the police for support. With the help of his former boss Captain Leland Stottlemeyer and his personal assistant Sharona Fleming, Monk has since solved the crime that no one else can solve. / Der Kriminalbeamte Adrian Monk wurde aufgrund seiner besonderen Fahigkeiten in seinem Beruf schnell eine kleine Beruhmtheit. Er hat ein fotografisches Gedachtnis und kann selbst aus kleinsten Hinweisen eine Spur basteln. Seit dem Tod seiner geliebten Frau Trudy durch einen mysteriosen Anschlag leidet er jedoch unter starken Ängsten und Zwangsstorungen, was zu seiner Suspendierung vom Dienst beim San Fransisco Police Department fuhrt. Nachdem er sich daraufhin drei Jahre lang in seiner Wohnung eingesperrt hat, macht er sich schlieSSlich als Privatdetektiv selbststandig und wird von der Polizei immer wieder um Unterstutzung gebeten. Mit der Hilfe seines ehemaligen Chefs Captain Leland Stottlemeyer sowie seiner personlicher Assistentin Sharona Fleming lost Monk seitdem die Kriminalfalle, die sonst niemand losen kann.

programme.title: SOKO Donau / SOKO Donau
programme.desc: The dedicated special commission of the Vienna Water Police investigates crimes in the greater area of ​​the Austrian capital. The criminal team's focus is on crimes that occur on and on the Danube and its tributaries. / Die engagierte Sonderkommission der Wiener Wasserschutzpolizei klart im GroSSraum der osterreichischen Hauptstadt Verbrechen auf. Der Fokus des Kriminalistenteams liegt dabei auf Straftaten, die an und auf der Donau sowie ihren Nebenflussen geschehen.

programme.title: Murder in the north / Morden im Norden
programme.desc: Finn Kiesewetter left the police service to run a farm. But when a fire destroys the farm, the burned-out ex-investigator returns to Lubeck and the police force. From now on he investigates here with Inspector Lars Englen. / Finn Kiesewetter hat den Polizeidienst verlassen, um einen Bauernhof zu fuhren. Doch als ein Brand den Hof zerstort, kehrt der abgebrannte Ex-Ermittler nach Lubeck und in den Polizeidienst zuruck. Fortan ermittelt er hier mit Kommissar Lars Englen.

programme.title: SOKO Kitzbuhel / SOKO Kitzbuhel
programme.desc: The Tyrolean lowland with its outstanding sporting and tourist offerings is the setting for the police team led by detective Karin Kofler and her colleague Lukas Roither, who specializes in criminal psychology, and who use a lot of expertise and empathy to put a stop to the local criminals. The investigators are supported by Karin's father Hannes, who runs the legendary "Pochlarner Stuben" inn and is blessed with a similar criminal instinct as his daughter. And finally there is Countess Schonberg, who, with her contacts with the Kitzbühel jet set, repeatedly proves to be a valuable help to the officials. / Das Tiroler Unterland mit seinen herausragenden sportlichen und touristischen Angeboten ist der Schauplatz des Polizeiteams um Kriminalbeamtin Karin Kofler und ihrem auf Kriminalpsychologie spezialisierten Kollegen Lukas Roither, die mit viel Sachverstand und Einfuhlungsvermogen den ortlichen Verbrechern das Handwerk legen. Dabei werden die Ermittler von Karins Vater Hannes unterstutzt, der das legendare Gasthaus "Pochlarner Stuben" betreibt, und mit ahnlichem kriminalistischen Spursinn gesegnet ist wie seine Tochter. Und schlieSSlich ist da noch Grafin Schonberg, die sich mit ihren Kontakten zum Kitzbuheler Jetset immer wieder als wertvolle Hilfe fur die Beamten erweist.

programme.title: “We move Austria” school / "Wir bewegen Österreich" Schule
programme.desc: The fun of sport and exercise is the main focus at WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH School. The aim of the ORF initiative is to reach students and teachers digitally with short exercise units and to have these take place every day in Austrian classrooms. Neither a gym nor sports clothing or special equipment are necessary. As an uncomplicated, daily exercise program for the classroom, WE BEWEGEN AUSTRIA wants to inspire schools to get more exercise and a healthy and balanced lifestyle. At the start of the expansion of the WE MOVE AUSTRIA initiative to the school sector, 30 episodes, each lasting six to eight minutes, with tailor-made exercises for everyday school life in the classroom are available. The focus is on strength, skill, coordination and relaxation in order to be able to better cope with the often stressful school day. The movement units are presented by qualified sports teacher Karin Augeneder. / Der SpaSS an Sport und Bewegung steht bei WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule im Vordergrund. Ziel der ORF-Initiative ist es, Schulerinnen und Schuler sowie Lehrerinnen und Lehrer auf digitalem Weg mit kurzen Bewegungseinheiten zu erreichen und diese damit taglich in den osterreichischen Klassenzimmern stattfinden zu lassen. Weder Turnsaal noch Sportbekleidung oder spezielle Gerate sind dafur notwendig. Als unkompliziertes, tagliches Bewegungsangebot fur das Klassenzimmer will WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH Schule fur mehr Bewegung und eine gesunde und ausgeglichene Lebensweise begeistern. Zum Start der Erweiterung der Initiative WIR BEWEGEN ÖSTERREICH auf den Schulbereich stehen 30 Folgen mit einer Dauer von jeweils sechs bis acht Minuten mit maSSgeschneiderten Übungen fur den Schulalltag im Klassenraum zur Verfugung. Im Fokus sind Kraftigung, Geschicklichkeit, Koordination und Entspannung, um den oft stressigen Schultag besser bewaltigen zu konnen. Die Bewegungseinheiten werden von der diplomierten Sportlehrerin Karin Augeneder prasentiert.

programme.title: On the edge of the pitch / Na ivici terena
programme.desc: The show "On the edge of the field" will reveal how our famous athletes live, far from their homeland, and how they defend the colors of the biggest clubs. What does their life look like in training and on the field where they leave heart, tears and sweat and how do they spend their free time when they are not winning points and titles. Our sports enthusiasts will prepare short postcards of the cities for you, and tell you something about the history of the clubs where our athletes win not only points in important competitions and derbies, but also the hearts of the fans. You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already made their mark in the history of major European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. Naši zaljubljenici u sport prirediće vam i kratke razglednice gradova, te vam otkriti ponešto o istoriji klubova u kojima naši sportisti vrtoglavo osvajaju ne samo bodove na važnim takmičenjima i derbijima, nego i srca navijača. Upoznaćete neke od slavnih srpskih sportista koji su se već upisali u istoriju velikih evropskih klubova.

programme.title: Cyrillic / Ćirilica
programme.desc: Popular television show by author and host Milomir Marić every Monday on ATV _ u! You will have the opportunity to watch everything that is not published even by scandalous tabloids. "Cirilica" brings the hidden background of events that are talked about the most and least known about! Milomir Marić brings together the incompatible, at the border where political propaganda and false promises stop, and reality begins. Politicians speak like ordinary people, without censorship and political platitudes. / Popularna televizijska emisija autora i voditelja Milomira Marića svakog ponedjeljka na ATV _ u! Imaćete priliku gledati sve ono što ne objavljuju čak ni skandalozni tabloidi. "Ćirilica" donosi skrivenu pozadinu događaja o kojima se najviše priča, a najmanje zna! Milomir Marić spaja nespojivo, na granici gdje prestaju politička propaganda i lažna obećanja, a počinje stvarnost. Političari govore kao obični ljudi, bez cenzure i političkih floskula.

programme.title: Persona / Persona
programme.desc: The series Persona is a Turkish crime drama from 2018 directed by Onur Sajlak, which magnificently combines true tragedy and the absurdity of life, and puts moral values ​​to the test of existence. The story follows Aga, a retired judge and widower, who has been diagnosed with Alzheimer's disease. Aware that he will soon forget everything, that nothing will remain of his personality and values, he makes a fatal decision - he will kill all the criminals who skilfully escaped from under the law. He embarks on a revenge campaign, and the task of finding out who in turn twists Istanbul's dirtiest souls and minds will fall to Inspector Nevra, who has been the jailer of her own life's storms for years. Will Aga and Nerva be opponents or will they join forces? How terrible will the network of secrets be, with the death of witnesses and oblivion? / Serija Persona je turska kriminalistička drama iz 2018. godine u režiji Onura Sajlaka, koja na veličanstven način spaja istinsku tragediju i apsurd života, a na test postojanja stavlja moralne vrijednosti. Priča prati penzionisanog sudiju i udovca Agu, kojem je dijagnostifikovana Alchajmerova bolest. Svjestan da će uskoro zaboraviti sve, da od njegove ličnosti i vrijednosti neće ostati ništa, donosi kobnu odluku – ubiće sve zločince koji su se vješto izvukli ispod ruke zakona. On polazi u osvetnički pohod, a zadatak da otkrije ko redom uvija najprljavije duše i umove Istambula pripašće inspektorki Nevri, koja je već godinama tamničar sopstvenih životnih bura. Da li će Aga i Nerva biti protivnici ili će udružiti svoje snage? Koliko će strašna biti mreža tajni, smrtim svjedoka i zaborava?

programme.title: Center of the day / Centar dana
programme.desc: An infotainment show that listens to the most current social topics and events that we comment on with guests from all social spheres. We bring viewers interesting things from the world of entertainment, culture, and art, and we often have regional stars as guests. The show is edited and hosted by Dragana Božić and Milica Nogo. / Infotaiment emisija koja osluškuje najaktuelnije društvene teme i događaje koje komentarišemo sa gostima iz svih društenih sfera. Gledaocima donosimo zanimljivosti iz sveta zabave, kulture, i umjetnosti, a često su nam u gostima i regionalne zvijezde. Emisiju uređuju i vode Dragana Božić i Milica Nogo.

programme.title: Agrarian / Agrar
programme.desc: The show is dedicated to farmers, but also to those who live in urban areas, have gardens, orchards, greenhouses. To those who want to learn something new and useful, they want to improve production and increase yields. / Emisija je posvećena poljoprivrednicima, ali i onima koji žive u urbanim sredinama, imaju baštu, vrt, voćnjak, plastenik. Onima koji žele da nauče nešto novo i korisno, žele da unaprijede proizvodnju i povećaju prinose.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

programme.title: Club energy / Energo klub
programme.desc: Our new Energo Club format will provide you with relevant current events in the field of electricity production, as well as the possibility of creating renewable sources and their sustainability. We bring the words of experts and the experiences of investors, we talk about system development, trends and successful projects, we inform about the most important events dedicated to energy. / Naš novi format Energo klub pružiće vam relevantne aktuelnosti iz oblasti proizvodnje električne energije, te mogućnosti stvaranja obnovljivih izvora i njihove održivosti. Donosimo riječi stručnjaka i iskustva investitora, pričamo o razvoju sistema, trendovima i uspješnim projektima, informišemo o najvažnijim događajima posvećenim energetici.

programme.title: ATV news / ATV vijesti
programme.desc: Overview of the most important news in one place, every working day in the most watched show of Alternative Television _ Central News exactly at 19:00 live from the studio. The news provides an overview of events in the Republic of Srpska, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the region and the world. Guests in the studio comment on current topics of the day. Journalists of the ATV newsroom research, discover and report on current events and phenomena in the sphere of politics, economy, society, social problems, city current affairs, sports and weather. / Pregled najvažnijih vijesti na jednom mjestu, svakog radnog dana u najgledanijoj emisiji Alternativne televizije _ Centralne vijesti tačno u 19:00 uživo iz studija. Vijesti donose pregled dešavanja u Republici Srpskoj, BiH, regionu i svijetu. Gosti u studiju komentarišu aktuelne teme dana. Novinari Informativne redakcije ATV _ a istražuju, otkrivaju i izvještavaju o aktuelnim događajima i pojavama u sferi politike, privrede, društva, o socijalnim problemima, gradske aktuelnosti, sport i vrijeme.

programme.title: Practice with Lidia / Vježbajte s Lidijom
programme.desc: In today's world, we often don't have time to exercise. There are many benefits of regular exercise. In addition to shaping your body, you are also assured of good health. In addition to good physical shape, exercise also contributes to good mental health. Exercise releases endorphins, which are the main trigger of good emotions and bring only positivity. / U današnjem svijetu često nemamo vremena za vježbanje. Mnoge su prednosti redovnog vježbanja. Osim oblikovanja tijela, osigurano vam je i dobro zdravlje. Osim dobre fizičke forme, vježbanje doprinosi i dobrom mentalnom zdravlju. Vježbanjem se opuštaju endorfini, koji su glavni okidač dobrih emocija i donose samo pozitivu.

Prve dnevne informacije, prvi jutarnji raporti sa terena širom Republike Srpske, zanimljivi prilozi iz svijeta politike, kulture i sporta, posvećeni ljudima i zanimljivim dešavanjima.

programme.title: Aloa face the forehead / Alo alo
programme.desc: One of the most popular British comedies of the 80s, set in World War II France occupied by German troops. In the small town of Nouvion, Rene runs the Artois cafe, a place for the French and Germans to hang out. Colonel Von Strohm asks Rene to hide a stolen painting in his cafe, which Hitler himself wanted at the same time. Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. programme.title: On the edge of the field / Na ivici terena
programme.desc: The show "On the edge of the field" will reveal how our famous athletes live, far from their homeland, and how they defend the colors of the biggest clubs. What does their life look like in training and on the field where they leave heart, tears and sweat and how do they spend their free time when they are not winning points and titles. Our sports enthusiasts will prepare short postcards of the cities for you, and tell you something about the history of the clubs where our athletes win not only points in important competitions and derbies, but also the hearts of the fans. You will meet some of the famous Serbian athletes who have already made their mark in the history of major European clubs. / Emisija "Na ivici terena" otkriće vam kako žive naši poznati sportisti, daleko od domovine, i kako brane boje najvećih klubova. Kako to izgleda njihov život na treninzima i na terenu na kojem se ostavlja srce, suze i znoj i kako provode slobodno vrijeme kada ne osvajaju poene i titule. Naši zaljubljenici u sport prirediće vam i kratke razglednice gradova, te vam otkriti ponešto o istoriji klubova u kojima naši sportisti vrtoglavo osvajaju ne samo bodove na važnim takmičenjima i derbijima, nego i srca navijača. Upoznaćete neke od slavnih srpskih sportista koji su se već upisali u istoriju velikih evropskih klubova.

programme.title: From morning until tomorrow / Od jutra do sutra
programme.desc: The series follows the life behind and in front of the cameras of the favorite TV couple, Srna and Marko. Apart from being a couple in the studio, the two have been a couple for years in their private life as well. However, what the audience doesn't even suspect is that their on-screen idyll has nothing to do with the one when the cameras go off - the two are actually living a nightmare. When Marko asks the director of the television to resign, in order to switch to a competing television, he receives a blow that puts him in a coma, and the director finds a doppelganger, the young actor Damjan. Damjan will have to play Marko for the Oscar, and will he succeed? Apart from the fact that their relationship with colleagues and friends, even rivals, will be complicated in an interesting way, with a lot of laughter and life situations, through the whirlwind of the busy life of the media, many secrets, both business and private, will be revealed, and some new loves and friendships will be born, and new avalanches of rivalries will start. / Serija prati život iza i ispred kamera omiljenog TV para, Srne i Marka. Njih dvoje osim što su par u studiju, oni su to godinama i privatnom životu. Međutim, ono što publika ni ne sluti, jeste da njihova idila na ekranu nema nikakve veze sa onom kad se kamere ugase – njih dvoje zapravo žive noćnu moru. Kada Marko direktoru televizije zatraži otkaz, kako bi prešao na konkurentsku televiziju, dobija udarac od kojeg pada u komu, a direktor pronalazi dvojnika, mladog glumca Damjana. Damjan će morati da odigra Marka za Oskara, a da li će to i uspjeti? Osim što će se na zanimljiv način, sa mnogo smijeha i životnih situacija, usložnjavati njihov odnos i odnos sa kolegama i prijateljima, pa i suparnicima, kroz vrtlog užurbanog života medija, na vidjelo će izaći mnoge tajne, i one poslovne i one privatne, i roditi se neke nove ljubavi i prijateljstva, i pokrenuti nove lavine suparništva.

Rene tries to balance his work in order to please the French Resistance and Nazi troops in order to survive. / Jedna od najpopularnijih britanskih komedija 80-ih godina, smještena u Drugi svjetski rat u Francuskoj koju su okupirale njemačke trupe. U gradiću Nouvion, Rene vodi kafić Artois, mjesto za druženje Francuza, a i Nijemaca. Pukovnik Von Strohm traži od Renea da sakrije u svom kafiću ukradenu sliku, koju je istodobno poželio i sam Hitler. Rene pokušava održati ravnotežu u svom poslu kako bi udovoljio francuskom Otporu i nacističkim trupama i tako mogao preživjeti.

programme.title: Boks / Boks
programme.desc: Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Do you need any more reason to follow this noble martial art? We find the first traces of boxing already in the third century BC on Sumerian drawings. In the modern age, the first rules of boxing were established in the 18th century in London and define the fighting area, equipment and illegal and allowed types of blows. Don't miss every opportunity to enjoy this exciting sport. / Roki Marčano, Majk Tajson, Šugar Rej Robinson, Muhamed Ali, Džo Luis. Treba li još koji razlog više da bi pratili ovu plemenitu borilačku veštinu? Prve tragove boksa nalazimo već u trećem veku pre Hrista na sumeranskim crtežima. U modernom dobu prva pravila boksa ustanovljena su 18. veku u Londonu i definišu prostor borbe, opremu te nedozvoljene i dozvoljene vrste udaraca. programme.title: MMA UFC Fight Night / MMA UFC Fight Night
programme.desc: Follow exciting duels in martial arts organized by the UFC. This association was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Las Vegas. / Pratite uzbudljive duele u borilačkim veštinama u organizaciji UFC-a. Ovo udruženje je osnovano 1993. godine, a sedište im je u Las Vegasu.

programme.title: MMA UFC 14 / MMA UFC 14
programme.desc: The term "mixed martial arts" was first documented in 1993 by American television critic Howard Rosenberg. He named this sport as a reference to the "Ultimate Fighting Championship" martial arts tournament. After that sporting event, that term slowly became accepted in the world. MMA has three phases of combat, which are divided into leg combat, clinch combat and ground combat. Every fight and round starts on the feet and then the fighters most often use boxing, kickboxing and Thai boxing techniques. In the clinch, the most common techniques are boxing and Thai boxing, while on the ground floor, knowledge of wrestling, judo, samba and jiu jitsu is used. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua.

programme.title: Boks / Boks
programme.desc: Rocky Marciano, Mike Tyson, Sugar Ray Robinson, Muhammad Ali, Joe Louis. Do you need any more reason to follow this noble martial art? programme.title: Borilački sport - MMA / Borilački sport - MMA
programme.desc: Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. On je tako nazvao ovaj sport radeći osvrt na "Ultimate Fighting Championship" turnir u borilačkim veštinama. Nakon tog sportskog događaja taj termin je polako postao prihvaćen u svetu. MMA ima tri faze borbe koje se dele na borbu nogama, borba u klinču i borba u parteru. Svaka borba i runda počinje na nogama i tada borci najčešće koriste tehnike boksa, kikboksa i tajlandskog boksa. U klinču su najčešće tehnike boksa i tajlandskog boksa dok na parteru se koristi znanje rvanja, džuda, sambe i džiju džicua. / Termin "mixed martial arts" se prvi put dokumentovano koristio 1993. godine od strane američkog televizijskog kritičara Hauarda Rozenberga. programme.title: Fudbal - Engleska liga / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. Biti prvak Engleske je cilj kojem teži svaki igrač Premier lige. / Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. programme.title: Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH / Fudbal - WWin Liga BiH
programme.desc: Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. Ulaskom kubova iz Republike Srpske dvije godine kasnije liga dobiva format sa 16 klubova u dvokružnom sistemu natjecanja. Danas se u ligi natječe 12 klubova koje se nakon 22 odigrana kola dijele na Ligu za prvaka i Ligu za ostanak. Prvi povijesni prvak BiH bio je Leotar iz Trebinja. Klub s najviše osvojenih naslova prvaka Zrinjski je iz Mostara. Najveći europski uspjeh plasman je Željezničara u polufinale kupa UEFA 1984. godine. / Osnovana 2000. godine Premijer liga Bosne i Hercegovine najviši je rang nogometnih natjecanja u BiH. programme.title: Košarka - NBA liga / Košarka - NBA liga
programme.desc: Šesti dan juna mjeseca davne 1946. godine zauvijek će promjeniti košarkašku igru. Tog dana u Njujorku osnovano je najelitnije svjetsko košarkaško takmičenje, NBA liga. 29 ekipa iz SAD-a i jedna iz Kanade svaku jesen počinje lov na legendarni prsten namijenjen prvaku NBA lige. Ekipe su podijeljene na istočnu i zapadnu konferenciju te kroz 82 utakmice regularne sezone love jednu od osam pozicija za doigravanje. Konferencijski prvaci ulaze u veliko NBA finale gdje u seriji od maksimalno sedam utakmica odlučuju o novom prvaku. programme.title: Rukomet - EHF Europska liga / Rukomet - EHF Europska liga
programme.desc: EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. Do tada se ovo takmičenje nazivalo IHF kup koje je svoju prvu sezonu odradilo u sezoni 1981.-1982. Od 2012. godine EHF kupu je priključen nekadašnji EHF Kup pobjednika kupova. Takmičenje se kao i Liga šampiona sastoji od dela gdje klubovi igraju po grupama i najbolji prolazi u "knock out" fazu. Nakon četvrtfinala na dvije utakmice između protivnika sijledi "final four". Polufinale i finale, kao i utakmica za treće mjesto, igraju se na jednu dobijenu utakmicu. / EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. programme.desc: EHF kup kako drugo po važnosti takmičenje za muške rukometne klubove u Evropi svoj put započinje 1993. godine. programme.title: Košarka - ABA liga / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. programme.desc: Najveća i najpopularnija liga američkog fudbala na svijetu NFL osnovana je 1920. godine, ali tek spajanjem s konkurentskim AFL-om sredinom prošloga veka, stvorena je današnja verzija takmičenja. U ligi nastupa 32 ekipe podijeljene u dvije konferencije. U toku regularne sezone svaka od ekipa odigra 16 utakmica. programme.title: Fudbal - Engleska liga / Fudbal - Engleska liga
programme.desc: Svakog avgusta 20 ekipa započinje lov na najcenjeniji trofej engleskog fudbala. Engleska Premier liga u formatu u kojem se danas igra osnovana je 1992. godine kao nastavak na Englesku ligu osnovanu davne 1888. Sezona traje do maja u dvokružnom sistemu gde svaka ekipa kroz sezonu odigra 38 utakmica. Prvi osvajač prvenstva je najtrofejniji engleski fudbalski klub, Mančester Junajted. programme.desc: ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Basketball - ABA league / Košarka - ABA liga
programme.desc: The ABA league was founded by the best basketball clubs from Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro, Croatia, Serbia and Slovenia. As such, it consists of clubs from the territory of the former SFRY, and representatives of Hungary, Bulgaria, Israel and the Czech Republic also participated in it. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. It changed its name several times depending on the sponsor, and today its official name is "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". The competition is played in two parts, the first part takes place with all teams playing two games, each against each other, one at home and one away, i.e. according to the two-round league system. The second part of the competition, i.e. the playoffs, differed from season to season. / ABA liga je osnovana od strane najboljih košarkaških klubova iz Bosne i Hercegovine, Crne Gore, Hrvatske, Srbije i Slovenije. Kao takva sastoji se od klubova sa prostora bivše SFRJ te su u njoj još učestvovali predstavnici Mađarske, Bugarske, Izraela i Češke. U nekoliko navrata je promjenila i naziv u zavisnosti od sponzora, a danas joj je službeni naziv "Adriatic Basketball Association (ABA) League". Takmičenje se igra u dva dijela, prvi dio se odvija tako što sve ekipe igraju po dvije utakmice, svako sa svakim, jednu na domaćem i jednu na gostujućem terenu, odnosno po dvokružnom liga sistemu. Drugi dio takmičenja odnosno plej-of se razlikovao od sezone do sezone.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Basketball - Champions League / Košarka - Liga prvaka
programme.desc: One of the youngest continental competitions for basketball players in Europe is the new Fiba "Basketball Champions League". The goal of this league is to compete with the organization "Euroleague Basketball S.L." and its Euroleague, which includes the strongest European clubs. In such a league, clubs acquire the right to perform based on placement in their own national championships, while in the Euroleague, the right to perform is acquired based on licenses. The competition system consists of two rounds of qualifications, the regular part, the playoffs and the final tournament of the best four, or popularly called the final four. The final is held at the end of April. / Jedno od najmlađih kontinentalnih takmičenja za košarkaše u Evropi je nova Fibina "Basketball Champions League". Cilj ove lige je konkurisati organizaciji "Euroleague Basketball S.L." i njenoj Evroligi koja obuhvata najjače evropske klubove. U ovakvoj ligi klubovi stiču pravo nastupa na temelju plasmana u vlastitim nacionalnim prvenstvima dok u Evroligi prava nastupa se stiče na temelju licenci. Sistem takmičenja se sastoji od dva kruga kvalifikacija, regularnog dela, plejofa i završnog turnira najbolje četvorice ili popularno zvani fajnal for. Završnica se održava krajem aprila meseca.

programme.title: Auto Shop Magazine / Auto Shop Magazin
programme.desc: Follow the show "Auto Shop Magazin" and stay up to date with the latest developments in the world of motoring. / Pratite emisiju "Auto Shop Magazin" i budite u toku sa najnovijim dešavanjima u svijetu automobilizma.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Great Sporting Moments / Great Sporting Moments
programme.desc: A magazine about the greatest moments in sports history. / Magazin o najvećim trenucima u istoriji sporta.

programme.title: Football: HNL / Fudbal: HNL
programme.desc: The Croatian Football League (HNL) was founded in 1992 and the first historic title was won by Hajduk from Split. Over the years, the competition system and the number of clubs have changed, but in recent years, the current system with 10 teams and a four-round format of the competition has been established. The transitional cup intended for the champion is the work of academic sculptor Marijan Zaradić. Dinamo from Zagreb won it the most times. / Hrvatska fudbalska liga (HNL) osnovana je 1992. godine i prvu istorijsku titulu je osvojio splitski Hajduk. Kroz godine sistem takmičenja i broj klubova se mijenjao ali poslednjih godina ustalio se današnji sistem sa 10 ekipa i četverokružnim oblikom takmičenja. Prijelazni kup namjenjen prvaku djelo je akademskog kipara Marijana Zaradića. Najviše puta osvajao ga je zagrebački Dinamo.

programme.title: Football - Serbian Superliga / Fudbal - Superliga Srbije
programme.desc: The Serbian Superliga premiered in the 2006/2007 season. In today's system, the league has 20 teams and functions according to the two-round competition principle. The history of the Superliga was largely marked by two great Belgrade rivals, Partizan and Crvena zvezda. Historically speaking, in terms of the number of titles won, the red and white part of the city is more successful. / Srpska Superliga svoju premijeru imala je u sezoni 2006./2007. U današnjem sistemu liga broji 20 ekipa i funkcionira po dvokružnom principu takmičenja. Historiju Superlige u najvećoj su mjeri obilježila dva velika beogradska rivala, Partizan i Crvena zvezda. Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Football - Romanian League / Fudbal - Rumunjska liga
programme.desc: The first football league of Romania has a long history, the first season was played back in 1909, when the now defunct Olympia Bucharest won the first title. Throughout history, the undisputed rulers of this league are Steaua and Dinamo Bucharest, who took most of the championship titles. Currently, the league has 14 clubs and after the "regular" part, where each team plays one game at home and one away, the league is divided into two parts. The first part is the play off for the champion, where the six best-placed clubs participate, while the rest fight in a special part for survival. / Prva fudbalska liga Rumunije ima dugačku istoriju, prva sezona je odigrana davne 1909. godine kada je prvu titulu osvojila danas ugašena Olimpija Bukurešt. Kroz istoriju neprikosnoveni vladari ove lige su Steaua i Dinamo iz Bukurešta koji su uzeli većinu titula šampiona. Trenutno liga broji 14 klubova i nakon "regularnog" dela, gdje svako sa svakim igra po jednu utakmicu na domaćem terenu i jednu u gostima, liga se deli na dva dijela. Prvi dio je play off za šampiona gde učestvuje šest najbolje plasiranih klubova dok se ostatak bori u posebnom delu za opstanak.

programme.title: Basketball - 2nd ABA League / Košarka - 2. ABA Liga
programme.desc: The 2nd ABA League is a league of the second level of the regional basketball ABA League. Krka Novo Mesto is the historic first winner of the ABA 2nd League, a competition that was founded in the 2017/2018 season. Along with the victory in the final four and the trophy for the winner, the Krka team also achieved placement in the 1st ABA league from next season. 12 teams participate in the league, and after the two-round system of matches, they are looking for a way to the four best teams and a place in the final four. The purpose of the ABA 2nd League is to enable smaller basketball communities to compete with stronger regional competition. / 2. ABA liga je liga drugog stepena regionalne košarkaške ABA lige. Krka Novo Mesto je istoriski prvi pobjednik ABA 2. lige, takmičenja koje je osnovano u sezoni 2017/2018. Uz pobedu na fajnal foru i peharu namjenjenom pobjedniku, ekipa Krke ostvarila je i plasman u 1. ABA ligu od sljedeće sezone. U ligi učestvuje 12 ekipa koje nakon dvokružnog sistema utakmica traže put prema četiri najbolje ekipe i plasman na fajnal for. Svrha ABA 2. lige je omogućiti manjim košarkaškim sredinama takmičenje sa jačom regionalnom konkurencijom.

programme.title: Football - UEFA Champions League / Fudbal - UEFA Liga prvaka
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format in 1992, the UEFA Champions League was founded, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. / Na prijedlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga prvaka, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Europe. Plasman u Ligu prvaka klubovi ostvaruju rezultatom u ligaškim takmičenjima svoje države. Finale Lige prvaka postalo je televizijski najgledaniji nogometni događaj na planeti.

Historijski gledano, po broju osvojenih naslova crveno-bijeli dio grada je uspješniji.

programme.title: Basketball - VTB league / Košarka - VTB liga
programme.desc: The VTB league brings together the best basketball clubs from Eastern and Northern Europe. In addition to the dominant Russian clubs, the league also includes clubs from Belarus, Estonia, Kazakhstan and Latvia. Throughout the history of the league, which was launched in 2008, clubs from Lithuania and Ukraine also participated. Starting with the 2013-2014 season. The VTB League is also a national championship for Russian clubs, the best placed of which becomes the champion of Russia. In order for clubs to join the league, they must have a hall with a minimum capacity of 3,000 spectators. The name of the VTB League comes from the general sponsor of the league, VTB Bank. FIBA Europe officially recognized the league in 2013. / VTB liga okuplja ponajbolje košarkaške klubove iz Istočne i Sjeverne Evrope. Uz dominantno ruske klubove u ligi prisustvuju još i klubovi iz Bijelorusije, Estonije, Kazahstana i Letonije. Kroz istoriju lige koja je pokrenuta 2008. godine sudjelovali su još klubovi iz Litvanije i Ukrajine. Počevši od sezone 2013.-2014. VTB liga je ujedno i nacionalno prvenstvo za ruske klubove, od kojih najbolje plasirani postaje prvak Rusije. Kako bi klubovi pristupili ligi moraju imati dvoranu minimalnog kapaciteta za 3000 gledaoca. Naziv VTB lige potiče od generalnog sponzora lige VTB banke. FIBA Evropa je 2013. službeno prepoznala ligu.

programme.title: Basketball - Italian league / Košarka - Italijanska liga
programme.desc: The long history of the Italian "Lega Basket Serie A" dates back to 1920 and its collapse. The first winner was the team from Kostana in the same year, 1920. This league is of great importance for European club basketball as a league that has given over 35 titles to its clubs in European competitions, starting with the Euroleague, FIBA ​​Saporta Cup and the Radivoje Korac Cup. The competition itself consists of 30 games that each team plays against 15 opponents in a round robin, followed by an eight-team playoff. The elimination matches are played on four won matches out of seven or in English terminology "Best of seven". / Dugogodišnja istorija italijanske "Lega Basket Serie A" datira još do davne 1920. i njenog osivanja. Prvi pobednik je bila ekipa Kostance iste te 1920. godine. Ova liga ima veliki značaj za evropsku klupsku košarku kao liga koja je dala preko 35 naslova njenih klubova u evropskim takmičenjima počevši od Evrolige, FIBA Saporta Kupa i Kupa Radivoja Koraća. Samo takmičenje se sastoji od 30 utakmica koju svaka ekipa igra protiv 15 protivnika dvokružno, nakon čega sledi plejof od osam ekipa. Eliminacione utakmice se igraju na četiri dobijene utakmice od sedam ili engleska terminologija "Best of seven".

programme.title: Football - Champions League / Fudbal - Liga šampiona
programme.desc: At the suggestion of the French journalist Gabriel Hanot, the Champions Cup was founded in 1955, an annual continental competition in which only the champions of their countries compete. With the media popularization of this format, the UEFA Champions League was founded in 1992, a competition for all the best clubs in Europe. Clubs are placed in the Champions League based on their results in their country's league competitions. The Champions League final has become the most televised football event on the planet. Real Madrid has won the most European championship titles. / Na predlog francuskog novinara Gabriela Hanota 1955. godine osnovan je Kup prvaka, godišnje kontinentalno takmičenje u kojem nastupaju samo prvaci svojih država. Medijskom popularizacijom ovog formata 1992. godine osnovana je UEFA Liga šampiona, takmičenje za sve najbolje klubove Evrope. programme.title: Cycling - Tour de France (M) / Biciklizam - Tur Francuske (M)
programme.desc: The Tour de France is an annual bicycle race through France with occasional visits to neighboring countries. It was held for the first time in 1903 and since then it has been held every year with a break of several years during the two world wars. The race is traditionally run in July for three weeks, it is about 3500 km long and consists of 21 stages and two days off. / Tour de France je godišnja biciklistička trka kroz Francusku uz povremene posete susednim zemljama. Prvi put je održana 1903. i od tada se održava svake godine uz nekoliko godina pauze tokom dva svetska rata. Trka se tradicionalno vozi u julu tokom tri nedelje, dugačka je oko 3500 km i sastoji se od 21 etape i dva slobodna dana.

programme.title: Cycling - Tour de France (Women) / Biciklizam - Tour de France (Ž)
programme.desc: Follow the Women's Tour de France, a road cycling stage race within the UCI World Tour. The first edition of this event was organized in 1955. This competition disappears from the calendar program in 2009 to return again in 2022. / Pratite Tur de Frans za žene, etapnu trku drumskog biciklizma u okviru UCI svetske turneje. Prvo izdanje ove manifestacije organizovano je 1955. Ovo takmičenje nestaje iz kalendarskog programa 2009. da bi se ponovo vratilo 2022. godine.

programme.title: Mountain Biking - World Cup, Electric Cross Country, Overview / Brdski biciklizam - Svetski kup, Električni kros kantri, Pregled
