programme.title: Lena Lorenz - Zerbrechliches Gluck / Lena Lorenz - Zerbrechliches Gluck
programme.desc: Food blogger Maja has decided to have a baby, even though Tobias, the father, is married. But Nele is a crybaby. Midwife Lena Lorenz sees that Maja needs support.Maja is in a dilemma. Although she and Tobias share a passion for fine food, she doesn't want to destroy his marriage. Lena can understand Maya's desire for independence. But the current situation is causing Maja to be overwhelmed. Tobias tries in his own way to support Maja and Nele. He and his wife Bettine ran an upscale restaurant together. Her two sons are still of school age, so Tobias hardly finds any time to really relieve Maja's burden. Lena doesn't want to interfere in his and Maja's affairs either. But then Bettine comes to her practice. Lena can confirm that she is ten weeks pregnant. Tobias becomes a father again, and Lena, who is the midwife for both mothers, gets into a loyalty conflict. While Lena and Quirin are enjoying his parental leave, Julia and Marlon are having a crisis. Julia wanted to be more involved in decisions, but Marlon does his own thing without consulting her. Basti also doubts his relationship with Franz because, apart from a few postcards, he doesn't let anyone hear about him. In addition, the work on the farm becomes too much for him, because Schorschi suddenly only has time for his duties as mayor of Himmelsruh. / Foodbloggerin Maja hat sich fur ein Baby entschieden, obwohl Tobias, der Vater, verheiratet ist. Doch Nele ist ein Schreibaby. Hebamme Lena Lorenz sieht, dass Maja Unterstutzung braucht.Maja steckt in einer Zwickmuhle. Sie und Tobias teilen zwar die Leidenschaft fur feines Essen, doch sie will seine Ehe nicht zerstoren. Lena kann Majas Wunsch nach Unabhangigkeit verstehen. Aber die jetzige Situation fuhrt zu einer Überforderung Majas.Tobias versucht auf seine Art, Maja und Nele zu unterstutzen. Er und seine Frau Bettine fuhren gemeinsam ein gehobenes Restaurant. Ihre beiden Sohne sind noch schulpflichtig, und Tobias findet von daher kaum Zeit, um Maja wirklich zu entlasten. Lena will sich auch gar nicht in seine und Majas Angelegenheiten einmischen. Doch dann kommt Bettine zu ihr in die Praxis. Lena kann ihr bestatigen, dass sie in der zehnten Woche schwanger ist. Tobias wird erneut Vater, und Lena, die fur beide Mutter die Hebamme ist, gerat in einen Loyalitatskonflikt.Wahrend Lena und Quirin dessen Elternzeit genieSSen, kriselt es bei Julia und Marlon. Julia mochte mehr in Entscheidungen einbezogen werden, doch Marlon macht sein Ding, ohne sich mit ihr abzusprechen. Auch Basti zweifelt an seiner Beziehung zu Franz, denn bis auf ein paar Postkarten lasst er nichts von sich horen. Daruber hinaus wachst ihm die Arbeit auf dem Hof uber den Kopf, denn Schorschi hat plotzlich nur noch Zeit fur seine Aufgaben als Burgermeister von Himmelsruh.

programme.title: Lena Lorenz - Fragile happiness / Lena Lorenz - Zerbrechliches Gluck
programme.desc: Maja finds out about Bettine's pregnancy and blames Lena for looking after both women and not telling her about it. In addition, Tobias does not provide any support. He only offers to cover the costs of childcare for Nele. Maja is disappointed and increasingly overwhelmed with her crying baby. The situation also comes to a head for Bettine: Tobias confesses to her his affair and that he is Nele's father. Shortly afterwards, Bettine begins bleeding. Will she lose the child? Fortunately, Lena herself finds great support from her family. Quirin is on parental leave and is working intensively on the loft conversion. But Lena notices that he would like to go on a hiking tour again. And since her mother Eva looks after her grandson with great enthusiasm, Quirin sets off on a mountain tour. But while Lena rushes to see Bettine in the hospital, Quirin finds himself in a dangerous situation when he helps a hiker who has slipped on a steep slope. / Maja erfahrt von Bettines Schwangerschaft und macht Lena Vorwurfe, weil sie beide Frauen betreut und ihr nichts davon erzahlt hat. Auch fur Bettine spitzt sich die Lage zu: Tobias gesteht ihr seine Affare, und dass er der Vater von Nele ist.Kurz darauf setzen bei Bettine Blutungen ein. Wird sie das Kind verlieren?Lena selbst findet zum Gluck bei ihrer Familie groSSe Unterstutzung. Quirin ist in Elternzeit und kummert sich intensiv um den Dachausbau. Lena merkt aber, dass er gerne einmal wieder eine Wandertour unternehmen wurde. Und da ihre Mutter Eva mit groSSer Begeisterung auf ihren Enkel aufpasst, macht sich Quirin auf zu einer Bergtour. Doch wahrend Lena zu Bettine ins Krankenhaus eilt, gerat Quirin in eine gefahrliche Situation, als er einem Wanderer hilft, der an einem steilen Abhang abgerutscht ist.

programme.desc: Karin Berger is exceptionally looking after the daughter of one of her clients. When she dozes off on a park bench, something happens: the little girl disappears without a trace. programme.title: SOKE / SOKO Wismar
programme.desc: Because of bad blood values, Chief Detective Jan Reuter is forced to undergo a treatment. But he can't calm down because a corpse suddenly appears in the mud bath. After all, he has a reputation to protect. Can he keep his cover? When his colleagues show up at "Baltic Vital Wismar", it becomes very difficult. At least Helene Sturbeck and Lars Pohlmann find out that their boss is not exactly fishing on Canadian lakes. But the whole thing has one advantage: the SOKO now has an incognito investigator. Because as it turns out, the victim, Steffen Reinhard, was poisoned with lead acetate over a long period of time. Did the perpetrator mix with the spa guests? On top of that, Steffen Reinhard had regularly embezzled funds and thus driven his company into ruin. His employee Bert Hohlbein was actually supposed to be his successor - he had no idea about the fraud. Did he take revenge on his boss? / Wegen schlechter Blutwerte wird Kriminalhauptkommissar Jan Reuter zu einer Heilkur verdonnert. Doch zur Ruhe kommt er nicht, denn plotzlich taucht im Moorbad eine Leiche auf.Reuter ware nicht er selbst, wenn er nicht sofort einen Fall fur die Kripo wittern wurde. Dummerweise hat er seinen Kollegen vorgegaukelt, im Angelurlaub in Kanada zu sein. Er hat schlieSSlich einen Ruf zu schutzen. Kann er seine Deckung wahren?Als die Kollegen im "Baltic Vital Wismar" auftauchen, wird das sehr schwierig. So erfahren immerhin Helene Sturbeck und Lars Pohlmann, dass ihr Chef mitnichten gerade an kanadischen Seen angelt. Einen Vorteil hat das Ganze aber: Nun hat die SOKO einen Ermittler inkognito.Denn wie sich herausstellt, wurde das Opfer, Steffen Reinhard, uber einen langeren Zeitraum mit Bleiacetat vergiftet. programme.desc: The body of trainer Sabine Leibnitz is discovered in the high ropes course. Both her colleagues and the course participants are horrified by the death. Who is behind the murder? programme.title: SOOO Koln / SOKO Koln
programme.desc: At a house party, 16-year-old Mathilde Bender gets into an argument with her boyfriend Leon Birkner. The next day, the schoolgirl is found dead in her room. Did he get out of control in the argument with Mathilde? Meanwhile, Mathilde's younger sister Greta makes serious accusations against herself - because without her the party would never have taken place. The SOKO finds out that she actually had a motive for murder: she used to be with Leon and was still suffering from the separation. Did jealousy turn into an argument that ended in death? The case takes a dramatic turn when Lilly discovers bruises on Mathilde's mother Anni. Is the image of the harmonious Bender family just a facade? programme.title: Die Rosenheim-Cops / Die Rosenheim-Cops
programme.sub-title: Was nicht passt, wird passend gemacht
programme.desc: Inspectors Stadler and Hansen investigate the murder of Leonore Rinaldi, a collector and dealer of Japanese antiques. She was found dead by her housekeeper in the morning. As it turns out, the victim had an argument with fellow antique dealer Oliver Jellsch, who discovered that she had sold him counterfeit collector's items. But she was also at loggerheads with her two children, Elisa and Theodor. There was a dispute, particularly with Elisa Rinaldi, a jewelry designer, about the repayment of private loans. During the course of the investigation, Rinaldi's housekeeper Brigitte Zapfenspicker also comes under suspicion because she is named in her employer's will as the sole heir to the considerable fortune. Police Chief Mohr is distracted from the investigation. A big fundraising gala by the volunteer fire department in cooperation with the music academy is coming up and his brand new uniform doesn't fit. Unexpected help comes from Ms. Nerlinger, who adjusts Mr. Mohr's uniform. But when it turns out that there was just a mixup when the uniform was delivered and Mohr mistakenly had a colleague's uniform made smaller, he has a problem: he has to find a new, matching uniform for his colleague - and quickly. / Die Kommissare Stadler und Hansen untersuchen den Mord an Leonore Rinaldi, einer Sammlerin und Handlerin japanischer Antiquitaten. Sie wurde von ihrer Haushalterin am Morgen tot aufgefunden.Wie sich herausstellt, hatte das Opfer Streit mit dem Antiquitatenhandler-Kollegen Oliver Jellsch, der dahinterkam, dass sie ihm gefalschte Sammlerstucke verkauft hatte. Aber auch mit ihren beiden Kindern Elisa und Theodor war sie im Zwist.Besonders mit Elisa Rinaldi, einer Schmuckdesignerin, gab es Streit uber die Ruckzahlung privater Darlehen. Im Verlauf der Ermittlungen gerat auch Rinaldis Haushalterin Brigitte Zapfenspicker unter Verdacht, denn sie ist im Testament ihrer Arbeitgeberin als Alleinerbin des beachtlichen Vermogens benannt.Polizeihauptmeister Mohr ist von den Ermittlungen abgelenkt. Eine groSSe Spendengala der Freiwilligen Feuerwehr in Kooperation mit der Musikakademie steht bevor und seine nagelneue Dienstuniform passt nicht. Unerwartete Hilfe kommt von Frau Nerlinger, die die Uniform fur Herrn Mohr anpasst. Doch als sich herausstellt, dass bei der Lieferung der Uniform nur eine Verwechslung vorlag und Mohr irrtumlich die Uniform eines Kollegen kleiner hat machen lassen, hat er ein Problem: Er muss fur den Kollegen eine neue, passende Uniform auftreiben - und zwar schnell.

programme.title: World famous and depressed / Weltberuhmt und depressiv
programme.desc: Empress Sisi, Winston Churchill, Konrad Adenauer, Marilyn Monroe and Robert Enke: Psychologist Leon Windscheid uses celebrities to guide us through the history of depression. He speaks to the famous psychoanalyst Erika Freeman, who treated not only Marilyn Monroe, but also Woody Allen, Marlon Brando and many other Hollywood stars.Leon Windscheid travels to the Maria Laach monastery, where Konrad Adenauer sought protection from the National Socialists. There he meets Prof. Hanns-Jurgen Kusters, who quotes from around 200 previously unknown letters from the first German Chancellor, in which suicidal thoughts are also mentioned. What was known about depression or corresponding states of mind in the protagonists' respective eras, and how did those affected themselves deal with it? How do we view the great personalities of world history with our knowledge today? Sisi was already said to have severe melancholy. The Empress never weighed more than 50 kilograms and was 1.72 meters tall. At the end of her life she only wore black clothes and avoided any contact with the public. This melancholy, which was already understood at the time as a mental illness, was only given the name depression in the course of the 19th century. Winston Churchill repeatedly experienced phases of persistent depression. He called these times “Visits from the Black Dog.” Leon Windscheid also meets Teresa Enke, the widow of German national soccer goalkeeper Robert Enke, who died by suicide in 2009. As chairwoman of the Robert Enke Foundation, she now strives to raise awareness about the disease depression. For the first time in this synopsis, the documentation explains the background to the stories of suffering in the individual biographies. / Kaiserin Sisi, Winston Churchill, Konrad Adenauer, Marilyn Monroe und Robert Enke: Psychologe Leon Windscheid fuhrt anhand der Prominenten durch die Geschichte der Krankheit Depression.So spricht er mit der beruhmten Psychoanalytikerin Erika Freeman, die nicht nur Marilyn Monroe, sondern auch Woody Allen, Marlon Brando und viele andere Hollywood-Stars behandelte.Leon Windscheid fahrt zum Kloster Maria Laach, in dem Konrad Adenauer vor den Nationalsozialisten Schutz suchte. Dort trifft er auf Prof. Hanns-Jurgen Kusters, der aus den rund 200 bislang unbekannten Briefen des ersten deutschen Bundeskanzlers zitiert, in denen auch Suizidgedanken erwahnt werden.Was war in den jeweiligen Epochen der Protagonisten uber Depressionen oder entsprechende Gemutszustande bekannt, und wie gingen die Betroffenen selbst damit um? Wie sehen wir mit unserem Wissen heute auf die groSSen Personlichkeiten der Weltgeschichte?Schon Sisi sagte man eine schwere Melancholie nach. Die Kaiserin wog nie mehr als 50 Kilogramm bei einer GroSSe von 1,72 Metern. Am Ende ihres Lebens trug sie nur noch schwarze Kleidung und vermied jeden Kontakt mit der Öffentlichkeit. Diese Melancholie, die man schon damals als psychische Krankheit begriff, bekam erst im Laufe des 19. Jahrhunderts den Namen Depression.Winston Churchill erlebte immer wieder Phasen von anhaltender Niedergeschlagenheit. Diese Zeiten nannte er "Besuch vom schwarzen Hund". Leon Windscheid trifft sich auch mit Teresa Enke, der Witwe des deutschen FuSSball-Nationaltorwarts Robert Enke, der 2009 durch Suizid starb. Als Vorstandsvorsitzende der Robert-Enke-Stiftung bemuht sie sich heute um Aufklarung hinsichtlich der Krankheit Depression.Erstmals in dieser Zusammenschau erlautert die Dokumentation die Hintergrunde der Leidensgeschichten in den einzelnen Biografien.

programme.title: Battle in the Mind: Living with Depression / Kampf im Kopf: Leben mit Depression
programme.desc: Invisible, underestimated and often misunderstood: depression. More than five million adults in Germany are currently affected by this mental illness. Michelle, Thorsten and Thomas speak openly about their experiences with depression and show how different the symptoms, causes and treatment options can be, but also how much they change the lives of those affected and their relatives. At least 20 percent of Germans experience depression once in their life, according to the Federal Ministry of Health. Anyone who has depression is not just "a little sad" - depression is a serious mental health disorder. Michelle (33) is a single parent, works and struggles not only with depressive phases, but also with feelings of guilt towards her children and the pressure to function in everyday life. Her depression is hardly visible to outsiders: she smiles and functions, even though she is often empty inside. She was diagnosed with depression when she was just 20 years old. In therapy, Michelle learns what is good for her in the difficult phases: sport, sauna - little time out just for herself. Her mother tries to be there for her, but cannot understand the illness. Thorsten (58), a business economist and passionate firefighter, has been trapped in his depression for years. He lives in seclusion with his parents and has not only lost his job but also his family due to the illness. Classic therapy - medication and psychotherapy - did not work for him: Thorsten is considered resistant to therapy. But his mother doesn't give up and during her research she comes across transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) at the Charite Berlin. TMS helps around 50 percent of patients with treatment-resistant depression. Can she help Thorsten too?Thomas (41) had actually achieved everything: top job at a global technology company, a family and social recognition. Failure was not part of his life. But then the collapse. From the outside, no one recognized what he looked like - until he couldn't even read anymore. Two stays in psychiatric care followed. Only when he realizes that he will never be “the same” again does the healing begin and he completely turns his life around. His wife is always by his side. / Unsichtbar, unterschatzt und oft missverstanden: die Depression. Mehr als funf Millionen Erwachsene in Deutschland sind aktuell von dieser psychischen Erkrankung betroffen.Michelle, Thorsten und Thomas sprechen offen uber ihre Erfahrungen mit Depression und zeigen, wie unterschiedlich die Symptome, Ursachen und Behandlungsmoglichkeiten sein konnen, aber auch wie sehr sie das Leben der Betroffenen und ihrer Angehorigen verandern.Mindestens 20 Prozent der Deutschen erleben einmal im Leben eine Depression, so das Bundesgesundheitsministerium. Wer eine Depression hat, ist nicht einfach nur "ein bisschen traurig" - die Depression ist eine ernsthafte Storung der mentalen Gesundheit.Michelle (33) ist alleinerziehend, berufstatig und kampft nicht nur mit depressiven Phasen, sondern auch mit Schuldgefuhlen ihren Kindern gegenuber und dem Druck, im Alltag zu funktionieren. Ihre Depression ist fur AuSSenstehende kaum sichtbar: Sie lachelt und funktioniert, obwohl sie innerlich oft leer ist. Schon mit 20 Jahren erhalt sie die Diagnose Depression. In der Therapie lernt Michelle, was ihr in den schweren Phasen guttut: Sport, Sauna - kleine Auszeiten nur fur sich. Ihre Mutter versucht, fur sie da zu sein, kann die Krankheit aber nicht verstehen.Thorsten (58), Betriebswirt und leidenschaftlicher Feuerwehrmann, ist seit Jahren gefangen in seiner Depression. Zuruckgezogen lebt er bei seinen Eltern, hat durch die Krankheit nicht nur seinen Job, sondern auch seine Familie verloren. Die klassische Therapie - Medikamente und Psychotherapie - hat bei ihm nicht angeschlagen: Thorsten gilt als therapieresistent. Doch seine Mutter gibt nicht auf und stoSSt bei ihren Recherchen auf die Transkranielle Magnetstimulation (TMS) an der Charite Berlin. Die TMS hilft rund 50 Prozent der Patienten mit therapieresistenter Depression. Kann sie auch Thorsten helfen?Thomas (41) hatte eigentlich alles erreicht: Topjob bei einem globalen Technologieunternehmen, eine Familie und gesellschaftliche Anerkennung. Scheitern gehorte in seinem Leben nicht zu seiner Vita. Doch dann der Zusammenbruch. Von auSSen hat keiner erkannt, wie es in ihm aussah - bis er nicht einmal mehr lesen konnte. Zwei Aufenthalte in der Psychiatrie folgten. Erst als er erkennt, dass er nie wieder "der Alte" sein wird, beginnt die Heilung und er krempelt sein Leben komplett um. Seine Frau ist dabei immer an seiner Seite.

programme.title: Terra X Harald Lesch / Terra X Harald Lesch
programme.desc: Depression affects millions, including increasingly young people. Researchers are deciphering how the disease changes the brain and finding new therapeutic approaches. What unbalances the psyche? How does depression occur? And what can you do about it? Harald Lesch meets experts from a wide range of research fields. The many puzzles surrounding this serious illness can only be solved through interaction. Depression is one of the most common mental illnesses worldwide. In Germany alone, almost 9.5 million people are affected. What's particularly alarming is that the numbers are also rising rapidly among children and young people. Nevertheless, not enough is known about what exactly happens in the brain when depression occurs. A German researcher is now getting to the bottom of the causes of this disease. She observes the processes in the brains of mice - live. The focus is primarily on the processes in which the so-called happiness hormone serotonin is involved. Serotonin has long been considered a central key in the fight against depression. Today we know that the matter is much more complex. Psychedelic active ingredients such as psilocybin - known from magic mushrooms - are now being researched for therapeutic purposes. The idea: The brain should be stimulated and brought out of its torpor. It is suspected that one cause of depression is a lack of plasticity in the brain, i.e. its ability to change its structure and function. The approach could be a glimmer of hope, especially in severe and treatment-resistant cases. What new findings does Germany's largest psilocybin study provide? What about the youngest? So far, only one drug against depression has been approved for them in Germany. The problem: Too little is known about the nature and causes of the disease. One thing is certain: the more it is decoded, the better children and young people in particular can be helped and targeted intervention. "Terra X Harald Lesch ... and the fight against depression" shows how science, medicine and society want to take away the horror of the disease. Joint efforts are needed because there are many paths that promise improvement. Depression can be treated. / Depressionen betreffen Millionen, darunter immer mehr junge Menschen. Forschende entschlusseln, wie die Krankheit das Gehirn verandert und finden neue Therapieansatze.Was bringt die Psyche aus dem Gleichgewicht? Wie entstehen Depressionen? Und was kann man dagegen tun? Harald Lesch trifft Experten aus den unterschiedlichsten Forschungsfeldern. Die vielen Ratsel um diese schwere Krankheit lassen sich nur im Zusammenspiel losen.Depressionen zahlen zu den haufigsten psychischen Erkrankungen weltweit. Allein in Deutschland sind knapp 9,5 Millionen Menschen davon betroffen. Besonders alarmierend: Auch bei Kindern und Jugendlichen steigen die Zahlen rasant. Trotzdem weiSS man noch nicht genug daruber, was bei einer Depression genau im Gehirn passiert.Eine deutsche Forscherin geht jetzt den Ursachen dieser Erkrankung auf den Grund. Sie beobachtet die Vorgange im Gehirn von Mausen - live. Vor allem die Prozesse, in denen das sogenannte Gluckshormon Serotonin beteiligt ist, stehen im Mittelpunkt. Serotonin galt lange Zeit als zentraler Schlussel im Kampf gegen Depressionen. Heute weiSS man: Die Sache ist viel komplexer.Psychedelische Wirkstoffe wie Psilocybin - bekannt von Magic Mushrooms - werden inzwischen therapeutisch erforscht. Die Idee: Das Gehirn soll angeregt und aus seiner Starre geholt werden. Denn man vermutet als eine Ursache von Depressionen eine mangelnde Plastizitat des Gehirns, also dessen Fahigkeit, seine Struktur und Funktion zu verandern. Besonders bei schweren und therapieresistenten Verlaufen konnte der Ansatz ein Hoffnungsschimmer sein. Welche neuen Erkenntnisse liefert die groSSte Psilocybin-Studie Deutschlands?Was ist mit den Jungsten? Fur sie ist in Deutschland bislang nur ein Medikament gegen Depressionen zugelassen. Das Problem: Man weiSS zu wenig uber die Natur und die Ursachen der Krankheit. Sicher ist: Je mehr sie entschlusselt wird, umso besser kann gerade den Kindern und Jugendlichen geholfen und gezielt eingegriffen werden."Terra X Harald Lesch ... und der Kampf gegen Depressionen" zeigt, wie Wissenschaft, Medizin und Gesellschaft der Krankheit ihren Schrecken nehmen wollen. Es braucht gemeinsame Anstrengungen, denn es gibt viele Wege, die Besserung versprechen. Depressionen kann man behandeln.

programme.title: The Kings Man - The Beginning / The Kings Man - The Beginning
programme.desc: After the violent death of his wife, Lord Orlando Oxford wanted to protect his son Conrad from the grind of war. But he cannot prevent the First World War from breaking out. A powerful enemy is pulling the strings in the background. With his Kingsman spy ring, Orlando tries to prevent the worst. - Star-studded action spectacle that doesn't take the historical events too seriously. South Africa 1902. When Lord Orlando Oxford (Ralph Fiennes), along with his wife Emily (Alexandra Maria Lara) and son Conrad (child: Alexander Shaw; adult: Harris Dickinson) attempt to deliver food to a Boer camp on behalf of the Red Cross, is killed Emily shot. From now on, the Lord's main task is to protect Conrad's life. 12 years later, 1914. Dark clouds are gathering over Europe. The First World War casts its shadow ahead. Orlando cannot prevent the assassination attempt on the heir to the Austrian throne in Sarajevo. He is faced with a powerful, conspiratorial organization that is pulling its strings in world politics through numerous influential men, including the monk Rasputin (Rhys Ifans), and is ready to involve humanity in a long and bloody war. But starting from a fine tailor's shop on London's legendary Savile Row, called Kingsman, Orlando organizes resistance against them Villains. To do this, he has integrated those people into his spy network who have their eyes and ears everywhere, especially in the front and back rooms of power - the service personnel. Orlando's personal, loyal entourage includes Polly Watkins (Gemma Arterton) and Shola (Djimon Hounsou). Prequel to the films "Kingsman: The Secret Service" and "Kingsman: The Golden Circle". The film features a number of German actors in important supporting roles, including Daniel Bruhl, August Diehl and Alexandra Maria Lara. The Brit Tom Hollander plays three roles: The German Emperor, the English King and the Russian Tsar were actually blood relatives through Queen Victoria. Rhys Ifans, once Hugh Grant's chaotic roommate in "Notting Hill", shines as the crazy monk Rasputin. Harris Dickinson (Conrad) caused a stir with appearances in films such as "Triangle of Sadness" and "Babygirl" and showed his directorial debut "Urchin", a film about a young Londoner, at Cannes 2025 homeless people. Harrison is slated to play John Lennon in a Beatles film adaptation by Sam Mendes. / Nach dem gewaltsamen Tod seiner Frau mochte Lord Orlando Oxford seinen Sohn Conrad vor den Muhlen des Krieges bewahren. Doch er kann nicht verhindern, dass der Erste Weltkrieg aufzieht.Ein machtiger Gegner zieht im Hintergrund die Faden. Mit seinem Spionagering Kingsman versucht Orlando, das Schlimmste zu verhindern. - Starbesetztes Action-Spektakel, das die historischen Ereignisse nicht allzu ernst nimmt.Sudafrika 1902. Beim Versuch, Lord Orlando Oxfords (Ralph Fiennes), gemeinsam mit seiner Frau Emily (Alexandra Maria Lara) und Sohn Conrad (Kind: Alexander Shaw; erwachsen: Harris Dickinson) im Namen des Roten Kreuzes Lebensmittel in ein Buren-Lager zu liefern, wird Emily erschossen. Fortan besteht die Hauptaufgabe des Lords darin, Conrads Leben zu beschutzen.12 Jahre spater, 1914. Dunkle Wolken ziehen uber Europa auf. Der Erste Weltkrieg wirft seine Schatten voraus. Das Attentat auf den osterreichischen Thronfolger in Sarajevo kann Orlando nicht verhindern. Er sieht sich einer machtigen, verschworerischen Organisation gegenuber, die mittels zahlreicher einflussreicher Manner, darunter der Monch Rasputin (Rhys Ifans), ihre Strippen in der Weltpolitik zieht und bereit ist, die Menschheit in einen langen und blutigen Krieg zu verwickeln.Doch ausgehend von einer feinen Schneiderei in der legendaren Londoner Savile Row, die Kingsman heiSSt, organisiert Orlando den Widerstand gegen die Schurken. Dazu hat er jene Menschen in sein Spionagenetzwerk eingebunden, die ihre Augen und Ohren uberall haben, vor allem in den Vor- und Hinterzimmern der Macht - das Dienstpersonal. Zu Orlandos personlichem, treuem Tross gehoren Polly Watkins (Gemma Arterton) und Shola (Djimon Hounsou).Prequel zu den Filmen "Kingsman: The Secret Service" und "Kingsman: The Golden Circle".Der Film zeigt eine Reihe deutscher Schauspieler/-innen in wichtigen Nebenrollen, darunter Daniel Bruhl, August Diehl und Alexandra Maria Lara. Der Brite Tom Hollander spielt gleich drei Rollen: Der deutsche Kaiser, der englische Konig und der russische Zar waren uber Konigin Victoria tatsachlich Blutsverwandte. Rhys Ifans, in "Notting Hill" einst Hugh Grants chaotischer Mitbewohner, brilliert als durchgeknallter Monch Rasputin.Harris Dickinson (Conrad) sorgte mit Auftritten in Filmen wie "Triangle of Sadness" und "Babygirl" fur Aufsehen und zeigte in Cannes 2025 sein Regiedebut "Urchin", einen Film uber einen jungen Londoner Obdachlosen. In einer Beatles-Verfilmung von Sam Mendes ist Harrison fur die Rolle von John Lennon vorgesehen.

programme.title: The Chelsea Detective / The Chelsea Detective
programme.desc: 80-year-old Celia Swanson is found dead in a luxury retirement community. It turns out she was killed. A trail leads into the past. The team led by DI Max Arnold finds out that the victim's husband was a rich South African entrepreneur, whom activists hold responsible for the deaths of numerous mine workers in the 1970s. Is it a late act of revenge? In Greyfriars West, a luxury retirement community, 80-year-old Celia Swanson (Sara Kestelman) is found dead in her bed. She had advanced neurological disease but did not die of natural causes. Coroner Ashley Wilton (Sophie Stone) discovers bruises that suggest she was forcibly injected. In Mrs. Swanson's apartment, the investigative team led by DI Max Arnold (Adrian Scarborough) finds a trail that leads back to the past. Her husband was a South African entrepreneur whom activists blame for the Nelspruit mining disaster. More than 80 workers died in the 1970s. DC Jess Lombard (Lucy Phelps) and DC Connor Pollock (Peter Bankole) question the activist Bandile Nkosi (Ladi Emeruwa), who repeatedly reminds of the victims with the organization White Wash. He confirms that he and his colleagues regularly invited Mrs. Swanson to their memorial events. But they had nothing to do with her death. Meanwhile, the investigators are wondering about Greyfriars West's rather dubious business model. Operator Stephanie Lang (Naoko Mori) could therefore have an interest in ensuring that residents die as quickly as possible. Freddie Mercer (Leo Staar), the partner of Celia Swanson's daughter Maria (Raquel Cassidy), also comes into the police's focus. The rowing club he runs appears to be in financial difficulties. Then Max finds out another detail from the Swanson family history that puts the whole case in a new light. / Die 80-jahrige Celia Swanson wird in einer Luxus-Wohnanlage fur Senioren tot aufgefunden. Es stellt sich heraus, dass sie umgebracht wurde. Eine Spur fuhrt in die Vergangenheit.Das Team um DI Max Arnold findet heraus, dass der Ehemann des Opfers ein reicher sudafrikanischer Unternehmer war, den Aktivisten fur den Tod zahlreicher Minenarbeiter in den 1970er-Jahren verantwortlich machen. Handelt es sich um einen spaten Racheakt?In Greyfriars West, einer Luxus-Wohnanlage fur Senioren, wird die 80-jahrige Celia Swanson (Sara Kestelman) tot in ihrem Bett aufgefunden. Sie hatte eine fortgeschrittene neurologische Erkrankung, ist aber keines naturlichen Todes gestorben. Gerichtsmedizinerin Ashley Wilton (Sophie Stone) entdeckt Blutergusse, die darauf hindeuten, dass ihr mit Gewalt eine Spritze gesetzt wurde. In Mrs. Swansons Wohnung findet das Ermittlerteam um DI Max Arnold (Adrian Scarborough) eine Spur, die zuruck in die Vergangenheit fuhrt. Ihr Mann war ein sudafrikanischer Unternehmer, den Aktivisten fur das Minenungluck von Nelspruit verantwortlich machen. Dabei kamen in den 1970er-Jahren mehr als 80 Arbeiter ums Leben.DC Jess Lombard (Lucy Phelps) und DC Connor Pollock (Peter Bankole) befragen den Aktivisten Bandile Nkosi (Ladi Emeruwa), der mit der Organisation White Wash immer wieder an die Opfer erinnert. Er bestatigt, dass er und seine Mitstreiter Mrs. Swanson regelmaSSig zu ihren Gedenkveranstaltungen eingeladen haben. Mit ihrem Tod hatten sie aber nichts zu tun.Die Ermittler wundern sich unterdessen uber das recht dubiose Geschaftsmodell von Greyfriars West. Betreiberin Stephanie Lang (Naoko Mori) konnte demnach durchaus Interesse daran haben, dass Bewohner moglichst schnell versterben. Ebenfalls in den Fokus der Polizei gerat Freddie Mercer (Leo Staar), der Lebensgefahrte von Celia Swansons Tochter Maria (Raquel Cassidy). Der von ihm geleitete Ruderklub scheint in finanziellen Schwierigkeiten zu stecken. Dann findet Max ein weiteres Detail aus der Familiengeschichte der Swansons heraus, das den ganzen Fall in einem neuen Licht erscheinen lasst.

programme.title: Around the world in 80 days / In 80 Tagen um die Welt
programme.desc: After a veritable crash landing with their hot air balloon, Fogg, Fix and Passepartout try to cross Italy by train. In Brindisi they want to catch a ship to Egypt. On the train journey, Signore Moretti, a businessman who despises all visionaries, plunges Phileas Fogg into serious self-doubt: Is he really the right person for the trip around the world? The three travelers are separated from each other on the train: Passepartout (Ibrahim Koma) is only given a place in third class as a servant, while Fogg (David Tenannt) and Fix (Leonie Benesch) are introduced to their sophisticated fellow passengers in the first class dining car. Among them is the Italian businessman Signore Niccolo Moretti (Giovanni Scifoni), who stands out with self-congratulatory anecdotes. He ridicules Fogg in front of those present as an unworldly ne'er-do-well, which arouses serious self-doubt in Fogg. Only two hours from Brindisi, the train comes to a bridge that was badly damaged by an earthquake. When the train comes to an emergency stop, a serious incident occurs that forces Fogg to go to his limits and beyond. Meanwhile, in Egypt, a certain Thomas Kneedling (Anthony Flanagan) receives a telegram from Nyle Bellamy (Peter Sullivan), Fogg's childhood friend and companion from the London Reform Club. Bellamy, who bet against Fogg, offers Kneedling £500 if he stops Fogg. / Nach einer veritablen Bruchlandung mit ihrem HeiSSluftballon versuchen Fogg, Fix und Passepartout Italien per Zug zu durchqueren. In Brindisi wollen sie ein Schiff nach Ägypten erreichen.Auf der Zugfahrt sturzt Signore Moretti, ein Geschaftsmann, der alles Visionare verachtet, Phileas Fogg in ernste Selbstzweifel: Ist ausgerechnet er wirklich der Richtige fur die Reise um die Welt?Die drei Reisenden werden im Zug voneinander getrennt: Fur Passepartout (Ibrahim Koma) ist als Diener nur ein Platz in der dritten Klasse vorgesehen, wahrend Fogg (David Tenannt) und Fix (Leonie Benesch) im Speisewagen der ersten Klasse ihren mondanen Mitreisenden vorgestellt werden.Darunter befindet sich auch der italienische Geschaftsmann Signore Niccolo Moretti (Giovanni Scifoni), der sich mit selbstgefalligen Anekdoten hervortut. Er macht Fogg vor den Anwesenden als weltfremden Tunichtgut lacherlich, was schwerwiegende Selbstzweifel in Fogg wachruft.Nur zwei Stunden von Brindisi entfernt gelangt der Zug an eine Brucke, die durch ein Erdbeben stark beschadigt wurde. Bei der Vollbremsung des Zuges kommt es zu einem folgenschweren Zwischenfall, der Fogg dazu zwingt, bis an seine Grenzen und daruber hinaus zu gehen.In Ägypten erhalt derweil ein gewisser Thomas Kneedling (Anthony Flanagan) ein Telegramm von Nyle Bellamy (Peter Sullivan), dem Jugendfreund und Weggefahrten Foggs aus dem Londoner Reform-Klub. Bellamy, der gegen Fogg gewettet hat, bietet Kneedling 500 Pfund, wenn er Fogg aufhalte.

programme.title: Emergency call harbor edge / Notruf Hafenkante
programme.desc: Nina Hell's shop was broken into and the furnishings were vandalized, but apparently nothing was stolen. For Hans and Franzi, the vandalism indicates an emotional act. Suspicion falls on the retailers in the area. They fight against online retail and boycott the acceptance of parcels in the neighborhood - so Nina Hell's parcel shop is of course a thorn in the side. But is that enough of a motive? The case becomes even more mysterious when the police find out that a package was stolen, and a short time later Nina Hell is pushed in front of a car and taken to the EKH with serious injuries. What is this really about? While Hans and Franzi continue to investigate Nina's environment, Mattes suspects internet fraud. Are the incidents all connected, or is it all just a coincidence? / In den Laden von Nina Hell wurde eingebrochen und die Einrichtung verwustet, doch anscheinend nichts gestohlen. Fur Hans und Franzi deutet der Vandalismus auf eine emotionale Tat hin.Der Verdacht fallt auf die Einzelhandler im Umfeld. Diese kampfen gegen den Onlinehandel und boykottieren die Annahme von Paketen in der Nachbarschaft - da ist der Paketshop von Nina Hell naturlich ein Dorn im Auge. Doch reicht das als Motiv?Der Fall wird noch ratselhafter, als die Polizei herausfindet, dass ein Paket gestohlen wurde, und Nina Hell kurze Zeit spater vor ein Auto gestoSSen und schwer verletzt ins EKH gebracht wird. Worum geht es hier wirklich? Wahrend Hans und Franzi weiterhin im Umfeld von Nina ermitteln, vermutet Mattes einen Internetbetrug. Haben die Vorfalle alle miteinander zu tun, oder ist das alles ein purer Zufall?

programme.title: SOKE / SOKO Wismar
programme.desc: Antje Breede fell from the cliff and had a fatal accident. But what at first looks like an accident turns out to be a gruesome murder. What happened to the single mother? To earn extra money, Antje Breede cleaned for Thiess Laurenz and his wife Corinna. However, the inspectors find out that there was more between children's book illustrator Thiess and cleaning lady Antje. Were they lovers? Did his wife Corinna know about it? Yes, indeed: Thiess Laurenz and Antje Breede were a couple. The children's book illustrator admits to the inspectors that he wanted to start a new life with Antje Breede. Did his wife Corinna get rid of her rival out of jealousy? But the victim's estranged husband - Jan Breede - also comes under suspicion. Apparently he has a real aggression problem. He simply doesn't want to accept the separation from his wife and three small children. Did Jan Breede kill his wife out of anger over the separation? / Antje Breede ist von der Steilkuste gesturzt, todlich verungluckt. Doch was zuerst nach einem Unfall aussieht, entpuppt sich als grausamer Mord. Was ist der alleinerziehenden Mutter passiert?Um sich Geld dazuzuverdienen, putzte Antje Breede bei Thiess Laurenz und seiner Ehefrau Corinna. Die Kommissare finden jedoch heraus, dass da mehr zwischen Kinderbuchillustrator Thiess und Putzfrau Antje war. Waren sie ein Liebespaar? Wusste Ehefrau Corinna davon?Ja, in der Tat: Thiess Laurenz und Antje Breede waren ein Paar. Der Kinderbuchillustrator gibt vor den Kommissaren zu, er habe mit Antje Breede ein neues Leben beginnen wollen. Hat seine Frau Corinna aus Eifersucht ihre Nebenbuhlerin aus dem Weg geraumt?Doch auch der Noch-Ehemann des Opfers - Jan Breede - gerat unter Verdacht. Offenbar hat er ein echtes Aggressionsproblem. Die Trennung von seiner Frau und den drei kleinen Kindern will er einfach nicht wahrhaben. Hat Jan Breede aus Wut uber die Trennung seine Frau umgebracht?

programme.title: Die Rosenheim-Cops / Die Rosenheim-Cops
programme.desc: The body of the hotel owner Prinz is found in the pool of the luxury hotel “Prinz Heinrich”. The first suspicion falls on the victim's wife, although she appears extremely dismayed. Prinz had a relationship with hotel employee Gesine Loblich. The fact that his wife Sabrina could have drowned him in the pool out of jealousy because she would have come away empty-handed in the event of a separation is a credible motive for the inspectors. Another lead leads to an extravagant hotel guest and his assistant. The alleged real estate investor Max Westinghaus is a fraud. Did Prinz have to die because he exposed Westinghaus's criminal plans? The perpetrator seems to have almost been caught when pathologist Dr. Eckstein makes an interesting discovery.Marie and police chief Gert Achtziger go to an event organized by the city of Rosenheim. Since Marie Hartl doesn't trust herself to look after the farm alone, she hires a farmer from the neighborhood. / Im Pool des Luxushotels "Prinz Heinrich" wird die Leiche des Hotelbesitzers Prinz gefunden. Der erste Verdacht fallt auf die Ehefrau des Opfers, obwohl diese sich auSSerst besturzt zeigt.Prinz hatte ein Verhaltnis mit Hotelmitarbeiterin Gesine Loblich. Dass seine Ehefrau Sabrina ihn aus Eifersucht im Pool ertrankt haben konnte, weil sie im Falle einer Trennung leer ausgegangen ware, ist fur die Kommissare ein glaubwurdiges Motiv.Eine weitere Spur fuhrt zu einem extravaganten Hotelgast und dessen Assistentin. Der vermeintliche Immobilieninvestor Max Westinghaus ist ein Betruger. Musste Prinz sterben, weil er Westinghaus kriminelle Plane enttarnt hat? Der Tater scheint fast uberfuhrt zu sein, als Pathologin Dr. Eckstein eine interessante Entdeckung macht.Marie und Polizeichef Gert Achtziger fahren zu einer Veranstaltung der Stadt Rosenheim. Da Marie Hartl nicht zutraut, den Hof allein zu versorgen, engagiert sie einen Bauern aus der Nachbarschaft.

Dazu Reise, Lifestyle und das Neueste aus der Welt der Stars und Sternchen.

programme.title: SOKE / SOKO Wismar
programme.desc: Sarah Spellmann's body is found at the Kuhldiek pond. The young woman had organized a tour on the topic of witch hunts the evening before. At the crime scene: a pentagram. Is this actually an ancient symbol of protection - or was it part of a modern witch ritual? The legend of the Witch of Kuhldiek still captivates many people today. Sarah was a member of a coven of witches. Did the young woman have to die because of her faith? The former city administration cultural officer recently started her own business as a travel guide with a focus on regional legends and myths. She offers spiritual healing on her website. There was no shortage of suspects. Sarah's sister Theresa accused her of getting involved in occult practices, which is why arguments broke out several times. And Marco Kostic was also angry with Sarah. He doesn't believe in this "esoteric nonsense." But since he and his wife Anika made a repatriation with Sarah, there has been tension in the marriage because Anika has developed an almost obsessive admiration for Sarah. And then there is Edda, the founder of the coven - a fortune teller who may have seen Sarah as serious competition. As the investigators get closer to solving the case, they are confronted with a dark chapter in Mecklenburg's history. / Am Kuhldiek-Teich wird die Leiche von Sarah Spellmann gefunden. Die junge Frau hatte am Vorabend noch eine Fuhrung zum Thema Hexenverfolgung veranstaltet. Am Tatort: ein Pentagramm.Eigentlich ist das ein uraltes Schutzsymbol - oder war es Teil eines modernen Hexenrituals? Die Legende der Hexe von Kuhldiek zieht auch heute noch viele in ihren Bann. Sarah war Mitglied eines Hexenzirkels. Musste die junge Frau wegen ihres Glaubens sterben?Die ehemalige Kulturbeauftragte der Stadtverwaltung hat sich vor Kurzem selbststandig gemacht, als Reisefuhrerin mit Schwerpunkt auf regionale Sagen und Mythen. Auf ihrer Website bietet sie spirituelle Heilungen an. An Verdachtigen mangelt es nicht.Sarahs Schwester Theresa warf ihr vor, sich in okkulte Praktiken verstrickt zu haben, deshalb kam es mehrfach zum Streit. Und auch Marco Kostic war wutend auf Sarah. Er glaubt nicht an diesen "esoterischen Quatsch". Doch seit er und seine Frau Anika eine Ruckfuhrung bei Sarah gemacht haben, gibt es Spannungen in der Ehe, weil Anika eine fast obsessive Bewunderung fur Sarah entwickelt hat. Und dann ist da noch Edda, die Grunderin des Hexenzirkels - eine Wahrsagerin, die in Sarah womoglich ernsthafte Konkurrenz sah.Wahrend die Ermittelnden der Losung des Falls naherkommen, werden sie mit einem dunklen Kapitel mecklenburgischer Geschichte konfrontiert.

programme.title: better: hypocritical snacks / besseresser: Scheinheilige Snacks
programme.desc: They are a must for any game or movie night: crunchy, delicious snacks. What's really in bread chips, crackers or Pretzel Bites? Sebastian Lege takes a close look.Sebastian Lege takes a close look at four popular snacks and shows how the industry tricks with lots of fat, cheap ingredients and deceptive packaging. He finds greasy pretzel bites, sugary honey-salt nuts, overpriced bread chips and seemingly light and airy crackers. They've been on our tables as a snack for decades: crackers. No matter whether with dips, cheese or the popular paprika flavor. The TUC brand in particular has established itself in Germany. Product developer Sebastian Lege recreates the cracker and reveals what's really in the supposedly light and airy baked goods: palm oil, cheap sugars and lots of flavor enhancers. Everyone knows pretzels from bakers, but the industry has long since turned them into a crispy snack: Pretzel Bites. They hardly have anything in common with the classic pretzel. Instead, the bites contain a lot of fat and additives - marketed under hip English names that are intended to turn the traditional pastry into a trendy snack. Together with baker Johannes Dackweiler, Sebastian Lege shows how it can be done easier - with less fat, but just as tasty. Nuts are considered healthy sources of energy, rich in proteins and valuable oils. An image that the food industry uses cleverly. There are many cashew-peanut mixtures with a honey-salt coating on supermarket shelves. Sebastian Lege reveals: The products contain little high-quality honey and sometimes only so-called baking honey, a cheap by-product of beekeeping. There is also a lot of sugar and coloring for the golden brown look. Bread chips sound like good baking and advertise a Mediterranean flair. But this image quickly crumbles: long shelf life, extra crunch and strong taste only work thanks to salt and lots of additives. And there is often more air in the pack than the contents. Sebastian Lege shows how the industry tricks, why many bread chips actually have a hole in the middle and how the snack can be made easier and healthier at home. / Sie durfen bei keinem Spiele- oder Filmeabend fehlen: knusprig-leckere Snacks. Was steckt wirklich in Brotchips, Crackern oder Pretzel Bites? Sebastian Lege schaut genau hin.Sebastian Lege nimmt vier beliebte Snacks unter die Lupe und zeigt, wie die Industrie mit viel Fett, gunstigen Zutaten und Mogelpackungen trickst. Er findet fettige Pretzel Bites, zuckrige Honig-Salz-Nusse, uberteuerte Brotchips und scheinbar luftig-leichte Cracker.Schon seit Jahrzehnten landen sie bei uns als Snack auf dem Tisch: Cracker. Egal, ob mit Dips, zu Kase oder in der beliebten Geschmacksrichtung Paprika. Besonders die Marke TUC hat sich in Deutschland durchgesetzt. Produktentwickler Sebastian Lege baut den Cracker nach und deckt auf, was wirklich in dem vermeintlich luftig-leichten Geback steckt: Palmol, gunstige Zuckerstoffe und ordentlich Geschmacksverstarker.Brezeln kennt jeder vom Backer, doch die Industrie hat daraus langst einen knusprigen Snack gemacht: Pretzel Bites. Mit der klassischen Brezel haben sie kaum noch etwas gemeinsam. Stattdessen stecken in den Bites viel Fett und Zusatzstoffe - vermarktet unter hippen englischen Namen, die aus dem Traditionsgeback einen Trendsnack machen sollen. Gemeinsam mit Backer Johannes Dackweiler zeigt Sebastian Lege, wie es auch einfacher geht - mit weniger Fett, aber genauso lecker.Nusse gelten als gesunde Energielieferanten, reich an Proteinen und wertvollen Ölen. Ein Image, das die Lebensmittelindustrie clever nutzt. In den Supermarktregalen finden sich viele Cashew-Erdnuss-Mischungen mit Honig-Salz-Mantel. Sebastian Lege deckt auf: In den Produkten steckt wenig hochwertiger Honig und zum Teil nur sogenannter Backhonig, ein gunstiges Nebenprodukt der Imkerei. Dazu kommen jede Menge Zucker und Farbstoff fur die goldbraune Optik.Brotchips klingen nach gutem Backerhandwerk und werben mit mediterranem Flair. Doch dieses Image zerbroselt schnell: Lange Haltbarkeit, extra Crunch und kraftiger Geschmack funktionieren nur dank Salz und jeder Menge Zusatzstoffen. Und oft steckt mehr Luft als Inhalt in der Packung. Sebastian Lege zeigt, wie die Industrie trickst, warum viele Brotchips eigentlich ein Loch in der Mitte haben und wie der Snack auch zu Hause ganz einfach und gesunder gelingt.

Aloa face the forehead / Alo Alo
programme.desc: France, World War II. René Artois is the owner of a small cafe, with unusual hardships. In his small cafe, a collection of various characters meet, from fighters of the French resistance movement, through Gestapo officers and German soldiers to British paratroopers. All of them try not to be discovered in their intentions, while Rene tries not to be discovered by his father-in-law and his wife in affairs with waitresses. / Francuska, II Svjetski rat. Rene Artoa je vlasnik malog kafea, sa nesvakidašnjim mukama. U njegovom malom kafeu se sastaje bulumenta raznih likova, od boraca francuskog pokreta otpora, preko oficira Gestapoa i njemačkih vojnika do britanskih padobranaca. Svi oni pokušavaju da ne budu otkriveni u svojim namjerama, dok se Rene trudi da ga tašta i žena ne otkriju u aferama sa konobaricama.

programme.title: Advocacy / Advokado
programme.desc: Brane and Beli are faithful friends, whose adventures we follow in this comic series. The two will try to find their way in a world where every attempt by an individual to break away from established conservative norms is viewed with fierce criticism. / Brane i Beli su verni drugovi, čije dogodovštine pratimo u ovoj komičnoj seriji. Njih dvojica probaće da se snađu u svijetu u kome se na svaki pokušaj pojedinca da se otrgne od ustanovljenih konzervativnih normi gleda sa žestokom kritikom.

programme.title: Portilova Andaluzija / Portilova Andaluzija
programme.desc: Michael Portillo explores Andalusia, and in meeting the local population, he shares their passions and interests. He tries his hand at pottery, visits a writer whose main theme is food, and takes part in the biggest street party in Spain at the Feria. / Majkl Portiljo istražuje Andaluziju, i u susretu s lokalnim stanovništom, dijeli njihove strasti i zanimanja. Oprobava se u grnčarstvu, posjećuje pisca čija je glavni tema hrana, a u Feriji učestvuje u najvećoj uličnoj žurki u Španiji.

programme.title: We are still green / Još smo mi zeleni
programme.desc: A show dedicated to young people, intended to educate and show young people in Montenegro a new angle of looking at their environment and the world. / Emisija posvećena mladima, namijenjena da obrazuje i prikaže mladima u Crnoj Gori novi ugao gledanja na njihovu okolinu i svijet.

programme.title: The Serrano family / Porodica Serano
programme.desc: Love brings two people together. After the wedding, what they already had is also combined - and that is their children. One of the most watched Spanish series of all time. A cocktail of laughter, love and optimism created by combining the seemingly incompatible. / Ljubav spaja dvoje ljudi. Nakon vjenčanja spaja se i ono što su oni već imali - a, to su njihova djeca. Jedna od najgledanijih španskih serija, svih vremena. Koktel smijeha, ljubavi i optimizma koji nastaje spajanjem naizgled nespojivog.

programme.title: Network.me / Mreža.me
programme.desc: We talk about people, events, places, problems, everything that interests you. Your stories, interesting guests. / Govorimo o ljudima, događajima, mjestima, problemima, o svemu što vas zanima. Vaše priče, interesantni gosti.

programme.title: Top five, Overview of European league goals / Petica, Pregled golova evropskih liga
programme.desc: Stay up-to-date with the events in the European football leagues - we bring you results, goals, the most interesting moments as well as the announcement of the upcoming round. / Budite u toku sa događajima u fudbalskim ligama Evrope - donosimo vam rezultate, golove, najzanimljivije trenutke kao i najavu predstojećeg kola.

programme.title: The land of wine / Zemlja vina
programme.desc: The distant past jealously hides the answer to the question of who, when and where blessed Montenegro with a noble lineage. In the storm of the ages, the epic struggle of vines and stone, myths and legends were born, as well as the magnificent splendor of viticulture and winemaking in Montenegro. / Daleka prošlost ljubomorno krije odgovor na pitanje ko je, kada i gdje blagoslovio Crnu Goru lozom plemenita roda. U buri vjekova, epskoj borbi vinove loze i kamena, nastali su mitovi i legende, ali i veličanstvena raskoš vinogradarstva i vinarstva Crne Gore.

programme.title: Football fest / Fudbal fest
programme.desc: With "Football Fest" find out football news and updates, follow analyzes of teams, matches and football competitions. / Uz "Fudbal fest" saznajte fudbalske vesti i novosti, pratite analize timova, utakmica i fudbalskih takmičenja.

programme.title: No worries / Bez brige
programme.desc: A collage-type show in which the hosts talk to guests about current topics in a relaxed atmosphere. / Emisija kolažnog tipa u kojoj domaćini u opuštenoj atmosferi razgovaraju sa gostima o aktuelnim temama.

programme.title: Autopulse / Autopuls
programme.desc: The magazine "Auto puls" brings news and interesting things from the world of motoring and the automotive industry. / Magazin "Auto puls" donosi novosti i zanimljivosti iz svijeta automobilizma i automobilske industrije.

If it's important, it's on Telejornal. / A mais rigorosa seleçao de notícias, todos os dias às 20h00. programme.title: News 21 / Notícias 21

programme.title: Special Information / Especial Informaçao
programme.desc: In the middle of the electoral campaign, the PS holds its congress. The main meeting serves to acclaim Paulo Cafofo's leadership. The president is looking here to boost his energy for the March 23 elections. The socialist congress will be covered on regional public television. / Em plena campanha eleitoral o PS realiza o seu congresso. A reuniao magna serve para aclamar a liderança de Paulo Cafofo. O presidente procura aqui o reforço de energias para as eleições de 23 de março. O congresso socialista terá cobertura na televisao publica regional.

programme.title: Everything and Economy / Tudo e Economia
programme.desc: Weekly program about economics, finance, macroeconomics, but also business, companies, markets and personal finances. programme.desc: News block with a look at the day that ends, clearly marking the relevance of the new day that begins. programme.title: Terra Europa / Terra Europa
programme.desc: The series follows the work of MEPs and European institutions like never before, through four new headings. Make Europe uncomplicated with the "European Dictionary". programme.title: Rear Window / Janela Indiscreta
programme.desc: Rear Window and its cinema program! programme.title: Futsal: Pripravljalna tekma: Hrvaška - Slovenija / Futsal: Pripravljalna tekma: Hrvaška - Slovenija
programme.desc: V pripravljalnem obdobju med sezonama in pred velikimi tekmovanji klubi in reprezentance vzdržujejo formo z igranjem prijateljskih tekem. Oglejte si prijateljsko tekmo v futsalu, znanem tudi pod imenom mali nogomet, ki se igra na manjšem igrišču, ponavadi v dvorani. Med seboj se pomerita ekipi s po petimi igralci, trenerji pa bodo dobili priložnost preizkusiti njihovo formo in uigravati različne taktične variante obrambe in napada. / V pripravljalnem obdobju med sezonama in pred velikimi tekmovanji klubi in reprezentance vzdržujejo formo z igranjem prijateljskih tekem. programme.title: Nogomet (M): B. Munchen - B Dortmund, Bundesliga 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): B. Munchen - B Dortmund, Bundesliga 2025/2026
programme.desc: Največja nogometna tekma v Nemčiji, Der Klassiker, bo v tej sezoni najprej odigran v bavarski prestolnici, Bayern gosti Borussio iz Dortmunda.Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. V najvišjem rangu nogometnega tekmovanja, ustanovljenega leta 1963, se pomeri 18 ekip, ki vsako leto v avgustu pričnejo tekme za priljubljeni krožnik. Največkrat ga je osvojil Bayern Munchen, in sicer kar 24-krat. Kultura navijanja, polnih tribin in vrhunskega nogometa je tisto, kar Bundesligo krasi od njenih začetkov do današnjih dni. Ne zamudite priložnosti, da uživate v tekmah Bundeslige. Zagotovo vam ne bo žal. / Največja nogometna tekma v Nemčiji, Der Klassiker, bo v tej sezoni najprej odigran v bavarski prestolnici, Bayern gosti Borussio iz Dortmunda.Ob vsem, kar nam je Nemčija skozi zgodovino dala, ponosno stoji tudi Bundesliga. programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

programme.title: Football (M): Koper - Maribor, First League Telemach 2025/2026 / Nogomet (M): Koper - Maribor, Prva liga Telemach 2025/2026
programme.desc: The Slovenian First League was founded in 1991, after Slovenia became an independent country with the breakup of the former Yugoslavia. Until 1990, the Slovenian Republic League was one of the lower leagues in Yugoslav football. Until the breakup of Yugoslavia, only a few clubs played in the highest football rank of the country at the time. After the establishment of independence, only two clubs were never relegated from the top tier of Slovenian football, namely Celje and Maribor. The league consists of ten teams, each of which plays four matches - two at home and two away, the last team in the standings is relegated, and the penultimate team fights for survival in the qualifiers. / Slovenska prva liga je bila ustanovljena leta 1991, potem ko je Slovenija z razpadom nekdanje Jugoslavije postala samostojna država. Do leta 1990 je bila slovenska republiška liga ena izmed nižjih lig v jugoslovanskem nogometu. Do razpada Jugoslavije je v najvišjem nogometnem rangu takratne države igralo le nekaj klubov. Po ustanovitvi neodvisnosti le dva kluba nikoli nista izpadla iz najvišjega ranga slovenskega nogometa, in sicer Celje in Maribor. Liga je sestavljena iz desetih moštev, od katerih vsako igra po štiri tekme - dve doma in dve v gosteh, zadnja ekipa na lestvici izpade, predzadnja pa se v kvalifikacijah bori za obstanek.

Ponarejevalci so po nekaterih ocenah z njo zaslužili celo več kot proizvajalec, farmacevtski velikan Pfizer. Po nekaj letih, ko so se pojavila konkurenčna zdravila, se je Pfizerjev tržni delež zmanjšal. Pomagali niso niti televizijski oglasi, v katerih so viagro oglaševale znane osebnosti, politiki in športniki. Pfizer se je zatekel k podkupovanju zdravnikov in zato v Združenih državah Amerike plačal milijardno kazen. Vendar je bila ta nizka glede na dobiček, ki ga je viagra prinesla proizvajalcu. programme.desc: Današnja gostja je Martina Piko-Rustia, direktorica Slovenskega narodopisnega inštituta Urban Jarnik v Celovcu. programme.title: Ivan in Karla, igrano-dokumentarni film, pon. / Ivan in Karla, igrano-dokumentarni film, pon.
programme.sub-title: R: Alma Lapajne... Igrano-dokumentarni film Ivan in Karla odpira pogled na razmerje med pisateljem Ivanom Mrakom in njegovo ženo kiparko Karlo Bulovec.
programme.desc: Predstaviti Mraka ni mogoče, ne da bi predstavili njegove zavezanosti Bulovčevi, ki je svoje ozkosrčne sodobnike razburjala tako s popolnim umetniškim talentom kot tudi s tem, da je več kot polovico svojega življenja prehodila z Mrakom.Seveda velja tudi obratno. Tudi Karlino življenje se nam odkrije kot celota samo, če si vzamemo pravico pogledati skozi Mrakova očala. Njuno sobivanje je bilo hkrati tudi medsebojno umetniško oplajanje skozi najbolj liričen medij: ljubezen.Kje so presečišča, kjer se dotikata drug drugega? Kje so odtujenosti in hladni dnevi samote? Zakaj bežita in se vedno znova vrneta? Ustvarjalci filma smo iskali odgovore na ta vprašanja in se znašli na produ hudournika, ki vztrajno odplavlja: smeh in jok, moč in šibkost, goloto in zakritost.Karla Bulovec: »Je to hudič v meni. Bog mi pomagaj! Razrvana in divja, da prav nikjer in v ničemer ne najdem miru, niti za trenutek, pa si ga tako želim. Vsak moment moram imeti spremembe.«Ivan Mrak: »Moški princip je prevladujoč pri Karli tako kot pri meni, zato se nikakor ne znajdeva v vsakdanjosti. V naju se nista iskali dve polovici, presenetljiva celost se je zgroženo prepoznala v nedoumljivi celosti. Tako sva postala brat in sestra – a tako, kot v pradobi, ko incest še ni bil bogoskrunstvo.« Na koncu zgodbe se nismo vprašali, kako je Ivan Mrak prenesel samoto po Karlini smrti. Če si dva človeka pomenita toliko kot sta si pomenila ona, je odhod enega izmed njiju preostalemu nezasuta jama.Bila sta drugačna in predvsem svoja. Filmsko pripoved je režirala Alma Lapajne. / Predstaviti Mraka ni mogoče, ne da bi predstavili njegove zavezanosti Bulovčevi, ki je svoje ozkosrčne sodobnike razburjala tako s popolnim umetniškim talentom kot tudi s tem, da je več kot polovico svojega življenja prehodila z Mrakom.Seveda velja tudi obratno. programme.title: S-prehodi: Martina Piko-Rustia, direktorica Slovenskega narodopisnega inštituta Urban Jarnik iz Celovca, pon. / S-prehodi: Martina Piko-Rustia, direktorica Slovenskega narodopisnega inštituta Urban Jarnik iz Celovca, pon.
programme.desc: Današnja gostja je Martina Piko-Rustia, direktorica Slovenskega narodopisnega inštituta Urban Jarnik v Celovcu. Znanstvena ustanova je poimenovana po priljubljenem duhovniku in borbeni osebnosti literarnega in narodnega preporoda iz Ziljske doline. Poleg pesmi in proučevanja koroške zgodovine je pisal tudi o avtohtonosti Slovencev na Koroškem. Podal je prvo zgodovinsko in družbeno analizo vzrokov za nazadovanje slovenskega življa na Koroškem. Podpisuje pa tudi prvo dialektološko razpravo o koroških slovenskih narečjih z naslovom »Obraz slovenskega narečja u Koruškoj«. / Današnja gostja je Martina Piko-Rustia, direktorica Slovenskega narodopisnega inštituta Urban Jarnik v Celovcu. Podpisuje pa tudi prvo dialektološko razpravo o koroških slovenskih narečjih z naslovom »Obraz slovenskega narečja u Koruškoj«.

programme.title: Osmi dan, pon. / Osmi dan, pon.
programme.desc: Ogledali smo si razstavo ob osemdesetletnici delovanja Arhiva Republike Slovenije, ki je postal osrednji varuh slovenske arhivske dediščine in s tem tudi kolektivnega spomina. Z razstavo v Arhivu med drugim poudarjajo ključno, a velikokrat prezrto vlogo te ustanove v sodobni družbi. V studiu bomo gostili filmskega montažerja Janeza Briclja, ki bo na prihajajočem Festivalu slovenskega filma v Portorožu prejel nagrado Milke in Metoda Badjure za življenjsko delo. Ogledali smo si tudi prvi lutkovni animirani celovečerni film za otroke, ki ima slovenskega režiserja in producenta. Zgodbe iz čarobnega vrta je film, ki skozi magične pripovedi predstavi tematiko izgube in žalovanja. Nastal je v sodelovanju čeških, slovaških in francoskih avtorjev, mi pa smo se o zanimivem procesu ustvarjanja, ki je prikazan tudi na razstavi v Slovenski kinoteki, pogovarjali s slovenskimi ustvarjalci. Pogovarjali smo se še z enim od najpomembnejših evropskih avtorjev, ki ustvarjajo na področju stripa in animacije, Benjaminom Rennerjem. Lahkotnost, iskren humor in sposobnost, da z otroško igrivostjo med drugim nagovori odrasle, odlikujejo tudi njegov najbolj znani animirani celovečerni film Ernest in Celestina, ki je prejel nagrado cezar in nominacijo za oskarja. / Ogledali smo si razstavo ob osemdesetletnici delovanja Arhiva Republike Slovenije, ki je postal osrednji varuh slovenske arhivske dediščine in s tem tudi kolektivnega spomina. programme.title: Like it was yesterday / Com si fos ahir
programme.desc: A group of former high school classmates meet again, after twenty-five years, at the funeral of one of them. The time at the high school turned them into a heterogeneous group, hooligans and full of life, but life dealt them very different cards. TV3's new bet on the table, after the end of La Riera, which was broadcast for eight seasons. As if it were yesterday takes place in Barcelona and the protagonists live spread over the entire geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d'ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present an everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even funny. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Ladies' paradise / El paraíso de las señoras
programme.desc: Betrayed by her boyfriend, Teresa leaves the village and flees to the big city. There he discovers that his uncle's store is going through difficulties due to the opening of a large warehouse El Paradís de les Senyores. / Traïda pel seu xicot, Teresa sen va de poble i fuig a la gran ciutat. Allà descobreix que la botiga del seu oncle passa per dificultats a causa de lobertura duns grans magatzems El Paradís de les Senyores.

As if it were yesterday takes place in Barcelona and the protagonists live spread over the entire geography of the city. The series, starring Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d'ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) and Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), wants to present an everyday life that can sometimes be raw, sometimes pathetic, but which can also be tender, light and even funny. / Una colla dantics companys dinstitut es retroben, despres de vint-i-cinc anys, al funeral dun dells. Lèpoca de linstitut els va convertir en un grup heterogeni, gamberro i ple de vida, però la vida els va anar repartint fitxes molt diverses.Nova aposta de TV3 per la sobretaula, despres del final de La Riera, que es va emetre durant vuit temporades. Com si fos ahir transcorre a Barcelona i els protagonistes viuen repartits per tota la geografia de la ciutat. La sèrie, protagonitzada per Marc Cartes (Poblenou), Aurea Márquez (Laberint d’ombres), Montse Germán (Infidels) i Eduard Farelo (Oh Happy Day), vol presentar una quotidianitat que de vegades pot ser crua, de vegades patètica, però que tambe pot ser tendra, lleugera i, fins i tot, divertida.

programme.title: Ladies' paradise / El paraíso de las señoras
programme.desc: Betrayed by her boyfriend, Teresa leaves the village and flees to the big city. There he discovers that his uncle's store is going through difficulties due to the opening of a large warehouse El Paradís de les Senyores. / Traïda pel seu xicot, Teresa sen va de poble i fuig a la gran ciutat. Allà descobreix que la botiga del seu oncle passa per dificultats a causa de lobertura duns grans magatzems El Paradís de les Senyores.

programme.title: The jungle: Episode 30 / La selva: Episodi 30
programme.desc: Xavier Grasset presents this afternoon magazine in which the current affairs of the day are reviewed in a relaxed way. programme.desc: The 16 best women's basketball teams fight for the league title. The competition is divided into a first regular phase in which the best classifieds access the playoffs for the title. programme.desc: The view of masculinity and sex has changed in Sweden over 200 years. From forced celibacy to Stockholm celibacy, the rights of homosexuals, contraceptives and changed divorce laws. programme.desc: A journey along an invisible but very powerful line: the one that divides (and unites) Ticino to Italy. Traced in 1521 and remaining almost unchanged to this day, this frontier is the scene of fascinating and often contradictory stories. From smuggling to cross-border workers, from refugees to spending across the border, up to the paradox of the Campione Casino. For almost five hundred years the border between Ticino and Italy has remained immobile, a line that has resisted time and events. But he was never silent. It is the oldest in Europe, born from a war: the Swiss conquest of Ticino, when by force of arms a frontier was drawn that was destined to last for centuries. Along this line, daily, contradictory and often absurd events have been layered, which together tell the great history of Europe. Here there was a fight for a pasture or a cow. Here the smugglers faced the night with panniers full of coffee and cigarettes, risking their lives to get through the ramina. Armies, refugees, cross-border workers and spies have passed through here, leaving scars and memories. There have been dark pages, such as the rejections during the Second World War, but also light stories, made of cunning and laughter born of fatigue. The border has been a wall and a bridge, a wound and a resource, tragedy and comedy at the same time. A stage spanning five centuries that still shapes our identity today. And to tell the story of its popular soul there is also Davide Van De Sfroos, who with his music and his words returns the ironic and melancholic voice of this frontier. A surprising and anecdotal journey that shows how our identity is not born only from great events, but from all those concrete and paradoxical events that have crossed - and continue to cross - the oldest border in Europe. An episode that intertwines history and legend, memory and irony, to discover while having fun how our border continues to tell who we are. A program by and with Jonas Marti. / Un viaggio lungo una linea invisibile ma potentissima: quella che divide (e unisce) il Ticino allItalia. Tracciata nel 1521 e rimasta quasi immutata fino a oggi, questa frontiera è teatro di storie affascinanti e spesso contraddittorie. Dal contrabbando ai frontalieri, dai profughi alla spesa oltreconfine, fino al paradosso del Casinò di Campione. Per quasi cinquecento anni il confine tra Ticino e Italia è rimasto immobile, una linea che ha resistito al tempo e agli eventi. Ma non è mai stato silenzioso. È il più antico dEuropa, nato da una guerra: la conquista svizzera del Ticino, quando con la forza delle armi fu tracciata una frontiera destinata a durare nei secoli. Su questa linea si sono stratificate vicende quotidiane, contraddittorie e spesso assurde, che insieme raccontano la grande storia dEuropa. Qui si è combattuto per un pascolo o per una mucca. Qui i contrabbandieri hanno affrontato la notte con le gerle piene di caffè e sigarette, rischiando la vita pur di superare la ramina. Qui sono passati eserciti, profughi, frontalieri e spie, lasciando cicatrici e memorie. Ci sono state pagine oscure, come i respingimenti durante la Seconda guerra mondiale, ma anche storie leggere, fatte di astuzie e risate nate dalla fatica. Il confine è stato muro e ponte, ferita e risorsa, tragedia e commedia insieme. Un palcoscenico lungo cinque secoli che ancora oggi plasma la nostra identità. E a raccontarne lanima popolare cè anche Davide Van De Sfroos, che con la sua musica e le sue parole restituisce la voce ironica e malinconica di questa frontiera. Un viaggio sorprendente e aneddotico che mostra come la nostra identità non nasca solo dai grandi eventi, ma da tutte quelle vicende concrete e paradossali che hanno attraversato - e continuano ad attraversare - il confine più antico dEuropa. Una puntata che intreccia storia e leggenda, memoria e ironia, per scoprire divertendosi come il nostro confine continui a raccontare chi siamo. Un programma di e con Jonas Marti.

programme.title: The lady in yellow / La signora in giallo
programme.desc: Murder, She Wrote (original title Murder, She Wrote) is an American crime drama series starring Angela Lansbury in the role of the protagonist Jessica Fletcher. It aired weekly on CBS from 1984 to 1996 and continued, with several TV movies, until 2003 (such as Sleeper Murder, The Rime of the Lost Boy and Appointment with Death). Angela Lansbury served as executive producer of the show in its final seasons. Jessica Fletcher is a perspicacious crime writer, who often finds herself dealing with mysterious murders, for which she always manages to discover the culprit. Jessica Fletcher lives in a small town, the fictional Cabot Cove in Maine. Although much of the success of Murder, She Wrote is due to the style and interpretative finesse of its protagonist, Angela Lansbury was not the producer's first choice. The part was initially offered to Jean Stapleton and Doris Day, who however turned it down. / La signora in giallo (titolo originale Murder, She Wrote) è un telefilm statunitense giallo, con la partecipazione di Angela Lansbury nel ruolo della protagonista Jessica Fletcher. È andato in onda settimanalmente sulla CBS dal 1984 al 1996 e continuò, con diversi TV-movie, fino al 2003 (come Vagone letto con omicidio, La ballata del ragazzo perduto e Appuntamento con la morte). Angela Lansbury ricoprì il ruolo di produttore esecutivo del telefilm nelle sue ultime stagioni.Jessica Fletcher è una perspicace scrittrice di gialli, che si trova spesso a che fare con misteriosi omicidi, per i quali riesce sempre a scoprire il colpevole. Jessica Fletcher vive in un piccolo borgo, la fittizia Cabot Cove nel Maine. Nonostante gran parte del successo de La signora in giallo sia dovuto allo stile e alla finezza interpretativa della sua protagonista, Angela Lansbury non è stata la prima scelta del produttore. La parte era stato offerta inizialmente a Jean Stapleton e Doris Day, che però rifiutarono.

programme.title: Bonfire / Falò
programme.desc: The gold of Rancate by Gaetano Agueci and Maria Roselli Gold has always been considered a safe investment; It's hard to imagine losing ourselves, and yet it happened, of course. Around 800 people spread across Switzerland, Germany and Austria are victims of a large-scale scam, which could cause losses of 84 million francs. At the center of the scam were some characters who had the Canton of Ticino as their base. And right south of the Alps, in Rancate to be precise, the refinery that transformed the raw metal coming from Africa was supposed to operate. Gold that probably never arrived in Ticino. All crazy about gold by Claudio Moschin They sift through the waterways of Lombardy and Piedmont, they know that those streams are rich in specks of gold. On the slopes of Monte Rosa this practice was already in vogue in Roman times, but today, with the prices of the yellow metal at historic highs, enthusiasts are on the increase. For some, the "gold rush" has become almost a fixed activity, while sales of shovels, sieves and washing boards are growing. And obviously there is a championship, with participants coming from all over Europe, to crown the best gold digger of the year. The hotels on Everest by Frank Senn and Jacqueline Schwerzmann Climbing to the top of the highest mountain in the world is no longer something that only interests mountaineers. The number of tourists is growing and with it the related offers; at the base camp, instead of after several days on foot, you can arrive comfortably by helicopter and once you disembark you will find rooms with services worthy of a hotel. A somewhat surreal environment, also told by an Italian-Swiss helicopter pilot who spends part of the year in the Himalayas. / L’oro di Rancate di Gaetano Agueci e Maria Roselli L’oro è da sempre considerato un investimento sicuro; difficile immaginare di perderci, eppure è successo, eccome. Circa 800 persone sparse tra Svizzera, Germania e Austria sono vittime di una truffa in grande stile, che potrebbe causare perdite per 84 milioni di franchi. Al centro del raggiro alcuni personaggi, che avevano come base dei loro traffici il Canton Ticino. E proprio a Sud delle Alpi, a Rancate per la precisione, avrebbe dovuto operare la raffineria che trasformava il metallo grezzo in provenienza dall’Africa. Oro che in Ticino, verosimilmente, non è mai arrivato. Tutti pazzi per l’oro di Claudio Moschin Setacciano i corsi d’acqua della Lombardia e del Piemonte, sanno che quei torrenti sono ricchi di pagliuzze d’oro. Alle falde del Monte Rosa questa pratica era in voga già ai tempi dei romani, ma oggi, con le quotazioni del metallo giallo ai massimi storici, gli appassionati sono in aumento. Per alcuni la “corsa all’oro” è diventata quasi un’attività fissa, mentre le vendite di palette, setacci, assi di lavaggio, sono in crescita. E non manca ovviamente un campionato, con partecipanti che arrivano da tutt’Europa, per incoronare il miglior cercatore d’oro dell’anno. Gli alberghi sull’Everest di Frank Senn e Jacqueline Schwerzmann Salire in cima alla montagna più alta del mondo ormai non è più una cosa che interessa solo gli alpinisti. La schiera dei turisti cresce e con essa le relative offerte; al campo base, invece che dopo diversi giorni a piedi si arriva comodamente in elicottero e una volta sbarcati si trovano stanze con servizi degni di un albergo. Un ambiente per certi versi surreale, raccontato anche da un pilota di elicottero italo-svizzero che trascorre parte dell’anno in Himalaya.

Vi si racconta lattualità, ma lo si fa con uno stile diretto, senza fronzoli, cercando di cogliere lattenzione del pubblico.

Meet Colin, a charming writer tasked with editing his as-yet-unpublished biography.
